text: Mopepe makasi, oyo eza pene ya 3 000 miles ya Miami, na Floride, aza na mipepe ezosila te ya 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Tonga ya acier ezalaki likolo ya mai mpona tension superficielle.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Bampasi na bisika esalemaka po biloko ezalaka na kati ya mai na likolo ya mai ebendanaka makasi yango na yango koleka ndenge ebendaka biloko ya mai oyo eza likolo na yango.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Bamolecule ya mai esalaka poso emonanaka te likolo ya mai, yango esalisaka biloko neti tonga na kotepa likolo ya mai.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Lolemo likolo ya patin ya glace ya mikolo na biso yo eza na basonge mibale na libulu na kati na yango. Basonge nyonso mibale esalisaka na kozwa glace malamu, ata soki etengami.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Po se ya razware ezalaka ya kobaluka mwa moke, razware ebalukaka na ngambu moko to mosusu, nsonge na yango etutaka oyo etutanaka na glace, ebalukaka mpe.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Oyo nde esalisaka patineur na kobaluka. Soki biloko babengi ba patins etengami na loboko ya mobali, patineur akobaluka na loboko ya mobali, soki yango ebaluki na loboko ya mwasi, patineur akobaluka na loboko ya mwasi.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Mpona kozongela nguya na bango ya kala, basengeli kolongola nguya oyo bazwaka na pole.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Basalaka yango na kobimisaka mwa ndambu ya pole babengi "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Bato ya siansi babengaka metode wana "kolendisa mpona kobimisa kongenga" po bapesaki atome moto na nzela ya pole makasi, esalaka ete ebimisisa pole ya photon, pe pole eza lolenge moko ya kongenga.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Elilingi elandi ezolakisa ba atome ezobimisa ba proton. Ya solo, na koloba solo ba proton eza mike mingi koleka ndenge ezomonana na bilili.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Baphotons eza lisusu mike koleka biloko oyo esalaka baatomes!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Enama ya ntina mingi na systeme circulatoire eza motema, oyo epompaka makila.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Makila eutaka na motema na batiyo babengi ba artères pe ezongaka na motema na batiyo babengi ba veines. Batiyo ya mike babengaka yango ba capillaires.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Mino ya tricératops ekokaki kopanza kaka te bakasa kasi kutu ata matambe pe misisa ya makasi.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Bato mosusu ya siansi bakaniska ete Triceratops aliaki ba cycas, oyo eza lolenge ya nzete moko oyo ezalaki mingi na Crétacé.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Banzete oyo eza neti banzete ya mbila ya mike oyo eza na matiti neti mitole.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops akokaki kosalela monoko na ye ya makasi mpona kolongola bakasa liboso ya kolia nzete.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Bato ya siansi balobaka ete banzete wana ezalaka na ngenge makasi, yango wana likoki eza te ete dinosaure nde esangisaki bango, atako lelo nyama babengi goigoi mpe banyama mosusu na ndakisa tiaku (oyo eza mwana ya ba dinosaures) bakoki kolia matiti to bambuma eza na ngenge.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ndenge nini gravite ekoki kobenda ngai? Soki ofandi na esika ya Io, okozala na kilo moke koleka soki ozalaki likolo ya mabele.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Moto oyo aza na kilo 200 pounds (90kg) na mabele akozala na bakilo pene ya 36 pounds (16kg) na likolo. Mpo gravite ebenda yo mingi te.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Moi ezalaka te na esika oyo okoki kotelema lokola Mabele. Moi mobimba esalema na mipepe, moto, pe plazma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mopepe ekomaka moke mingi ntango ozopusana pene ya katikati ya moi.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Eteni ya libanda oyo tomonaka ntango totalaka moi babengaka yango potosphere, oyo elimboli "boule ya pole".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Pene ya mibu nkoto misato na nsima, na 1610, moto ya astronomie ya Italie Galileo Galilei asalelaki telescope mpona komona ete Venus eza na bafase, neti kaka sanza.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Bileko esalemaka mpona kaka ndambu moko ya Vénus (to ya Sanza) oyo etalanaka na Moi nde eza na pole. Bileko ya Vénus esimbaka mateya ya Copernic oyo elobaka ete baplanete ebalukaka zingazinga ya Moi.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: na nsima, mwa bambula na nsima na 1639, moto ya astronomi ya Angleterre, Jeremiah Horrokc, amonaki nzela ya Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Angleterre ezalaki na eleko molai ya kimia nsima ya kobotola lisusu Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Kasi na 991, Ethelred ekutanaki na masuwa moko ya Viking oyo elekaki nyonso na monene banda Guthrum ekeke moko eleki.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Mokumbi ya masuwa wana eza Olaf Trygvasson, moto moko ya Norvége oyo azalaki na mposa ya kobotola mboka na ye na maboko ya bato ya Danemark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ezali alfabe moko pamba oyo basala na ntina mpe basalelaka yango mokolo nyonso. Basalaki alfabe na 1444 na nse ya boyangeli ya mokonzi Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mokonzi Sejong azalaka mokonzi ya minei ya libota ya ba Joseon pe aza mokonzi oyo bato balingaka mingi koleka.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Na ebandeli apesaki yango nkombo alfabe ya Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, oyo elimboli "makelele ya malamu mpona koteya bato".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Eza na mateya mingi oyo elobelaka ndenge Sanskrit ebimaki. Moko na yango elobelaka moto moko ya Aryan oyo alongwaki na weste mpe akendaki na Inde, mpe amemaki lokota na bango elongo na bango.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit eza lokota moko ya kala mpe eza ndenge moko na lokota ya Latin oyo balobaka na Eropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku ya kala koleka oyo eyebana na mokili ekomamaki na Sanskrit. na nsima na kosangisa yango na Upanishads, Sanskrit ebebaki na yango mpo ezalaka kala.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit eza lokota moko ya mpasi mingi oyo eza na maloba mingi, yango nde esalisaka mpona kosala balokota mingi ya Inde ya lelo, kaka ndenge Latin esalisa mpona kosala balokota ya Erope neti Francais pe Espagnole.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Lokola bitumba ya France esilaki, Allemagne ebandaki kobongama mpona kokota na makasi na Grande-Bretagne.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Allemagne ebengaka bitumba wana "Mosala Sealion". Mandoki mingi ya makasi ya Grande Bretagne pe bibundeli ya basoda na bango ebungaki na ntango balongwaki na Dunkerque, yango wana basoda bazalaki makasi mingi te.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Kasi Royal Navy ezalaki lisusu makasi mingi koleka basoda ya Allemagne ("Kriegsmarine") mpe ekokaki koboma masuwa nyonso oyo ezalaki koleka na nzela ya Angleterre.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kasi, masuwa mingi ya Royal Navy ezalaki pene ya banzela oyo banguna basalelaki po ba amiraux bazalaki kobanga ete basoda ya Allemagne oyo babundaka na likolo basilisa bango.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tobanda na kolimbola miango ya Italie. Italie ezalaki mingimingi "leki ya mobali" ya Allemagne na Japon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Azalaki na basoda ya makasi pe basoda ya mai ya makasi, atako bautaki kotonga masuwa minei ya sika kala te liboso ya ebandeli ya bitumba.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Mikano ya ntina mingi ya Italie ezali mikili ya Afrika. mpona kozwa mikili wana, bakozala na bosenga ya masuwa mpona komema basoda na bango, mpo basoda wana bakatisa mbu ya Méditerranée mpe bakende kobotola Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Mpona yango, balongolaki bitika ya bamasuwa ya Grande Bretagne na Egypte. Longola makambo wana, masuwa ya bitumba ya bato ya Italie ezalaki na eloko mosusu te.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Sikoyo mpona Japon. Japon ezalaki esanga-mboka, kaka lokola Grande Bretagne.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ba sous-marins eza masuwa oyo basala mpona kotambola na se ya mai pe kofanda kuna na eleko ya molai.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Basalelaki basous-marins na bitumba ya liboso pe ya mibale ye mokili mobimba. Na ntango wana, ezalaki kotambola malembe mpenza pe ezalaki na masasi mingi te.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Na ebandeli ya bitumba bazalaki kosala mibembo mbala mingi na mbu, kasi ntango babandaka kosala baradare pe yango ezalaki sikisiki, basoda babundaka na mai bakomaki kokende na se ya mai mpo bato bamona bango te.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Bazalaka kobenga basoda ya Allemagne ya mai U-Boats. Bato ya Allemagne bayebaki malamu kotambola na ebale mpe kosalela bamasuwa na bango ya basoda.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Mpona bolongi na bango na basoda babundaka na mai, nsima ya bitumba, eza neti bato ya Allemagne baza na yango ebele te.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ya solo! Mokonzi Tutankhamun, oyo bazalaki kobenga ntango mosusu "Mokonzi Tut" to "Mokonzi ya Elenge", aza moko ya bakonzi oyo bayebana mingi na mikolo na biso na kati ya bakonzi ya Egypte ya kala.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Likambo ya esengo, bazalaki komona yango ntina mingi te na ntango ya kala pe bakomisaki yango te na baliste mingi ya bakonzi ya kala.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Kasi, ndenge bamonaki lilita na ye na 1922 esalaki ete ayebana mingi. Ata soki malita mingi ya kala bayiba yango, lilita wana etikala kaka ndenge ezalaki.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Biloko ebele oyo bakunda na Toutankhamon, babatela yango malamu, ata mpe biloko ebele oyo basala na bibende ya ntina pe mabanga oyo emonanaka mingi te.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kosala baroues eza na barayons esala ete makalo ya Assyrie ekoma pepele, mbango mingi, mpe ebongama mpona koleka basoda mosusu mpe makalo mosusu.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Makula euti na baarbalètes oyo ebomaka ekoki kokota na ebundeli ya basoda ya banguna. Pene ya mobu 1000 liboso ya ntango na biso, bato ya Asiria babimisaki cavalerie ya liboso.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Cavalier eza soda oyo abundaka likolo ya mpunda. Lokola basalaki naino te esika ya kofandela, basoda ya Assirie oyo babundaki likolo ya mpunda bafandaki kaka boye likolo ya bampunda na bitumba.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Toyebi bato ya politiki, ya siansi pe ya mayemi ya Grese. Mbala mosusu moto ayebani mingi ezali Homer, poete oyo akufa miso pe ayebana mingi, oyo akomi bapoeme ya kitoko makasi ya Grese ya kala: poeme ebengami Iliad pe Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocle na Aristophane baza kaka bakomi miziki bayebana mingi pe biloko na bango ezalaka na kati ya misala ya ntina mingi na mankombo ya kokoma.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Moto ya Grece mosusu oyo ayebana mingi eza moto ya mathematique Pythagore, ayebana mingi mpona makanisi na ye na ntina etali boyokani na kati ya bandambo ya batriangles oyo eza rectangle.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Eza na makanisi ekeseni na talo ya bato oyo balobaka lokota ya Hindi. Bato balobaka ete eza kati ya lokota ya mibale pe ya minei oyo bato mingi balobaka na mokili.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Talo ya bana-mboka oyo balobaki yango ekeseni na kotalela soki eza to te na boyokani na minoko ebele ya mboka.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Emonani bato kati na bamilio 340 kino na bamilio 500, pe kino na bato bamilio 800 bakoki koyeba lokota.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi na Urdu eza na ndenge moko ndimbola kasi makomi ekeseni; na masolo ya mokolo na mokolo, balobi ya lokota nyonso mibale bakoki kosolola malamu.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Pene ya ekeke ya 15, nordi ya Estonie ezalaki mpenza kolanda bizaleli ya bato ya Allemagne.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Bamoine mosusu ya Allemagne balingaki kobenda Nzambe pene ya bato ya bamboka wana, yango wana babimisaki lokota ya pete ya Estonie.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Eutaki na alfabe ya Allemagne pe elembo moko "Õ/õ" ebakisamaki.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Nsima ya bambula, babandaka kodefa maloba mingi na lokota ya Allemagne. Ezalaki ebandeli ya kongengisama.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Mbala mingi, mokitani na kiti ya bokonzi ekendaka mbala moko na soda nsima ya kosilisa kelasi.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kasi, Charles akendaki na université na Trinity College, na Cambridge, esika ayekolaka anthropologie na archéologie, na nsima ayekolaki makambo ya kala, azwaki 2:2 (diplome moko ya nivo ya mibale ya se).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles azalaki moto ya liboso ya libota ya bokonzi ya Grande Bretagne oyo azwaki diplome.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turquie ya Eropa (Thrace ya este to Roumélie na esanga ya Balkan) eza na 3% ya ekolo.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Teritware ya Turquie eza molai bakilometele koleka 1 600 (1 000 mi) pe 800 km (500 mi) na monene, ezalaka lokola rectangle.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Bonene ya Turquie, ata mpe balacs, ezali 783 562 kilomètres carrés (300 948 miles carrés); 755 688 kilomètres carrés (291 773 miles carrés) eza na Asie ya sudi weste mpe 23 764 kilomètres carrés (9174 miles carrés) na Eropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Bonene ya Turquie esalaka ete ezala mokili ya 37 ya monene na mokili; mpe eza pene ya monene ya France na Royaume-Uni soki osangisai yango.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquie ezingami na bambu na bandambu misato: Mbu Égée na weste, mbu moindo na nordi pe mbu ya Mediterane na Sudi.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg eza na lisolo ya kala kasi ezwaki lipanda na 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Biteni ya Belgique ya lelo ezalaki naino na Luxembourg na kala kasi ekoma ya Belgique nsima ya botomboki ya Belgique ya mibu 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg elingaka ntango nyonso kokota te na makambo ya bato kasi Allemagne ekotelaki yango na bitumba ya liboso mpe ya mibale ya mokili mobimba.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Na 1957, Luxembourg ekomaki na kati ya mikili oyo esalaki lisanga oyo eyebana lelo na nkombo ya Union européenne.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong eza esika moko ya makasi oyo ekoma batika pe monastere ya bato ya Buda na eteni ya likolo ya etuka ya Paro (na mboka Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Balobaka ete na mobu 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel atongaka ndako ya makasi mpona kokanisa ndenge balongaki basoda ya Tibetain-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Na 1951, moto moko ezikisaki biloko mingi etikaki kaka mwa biloko moke na Drukgyal Dzong, na ndakisa foto ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: nsima ya moto, babatelaki esika makasi mpe ekufaki te, etikala moko ya bisika ya kitoko koleka ya Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Na ekeke ya 18, Cambodge ekangamaki na kati ya baninga mibale ya makasi, Thaïlande na Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Bato ya Thaïlande bakotaki na makasi na Cambodge mbala mingi na ekeke ya 18 mpe na mobu 1772, babomaki Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Na bambula ya suka ya ekeke ya 18 Vietnam ekendaki kobundisa mpe Cambodge.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Bato ya Vénézuéla zomi na mwambe na kati ya mokama bazangi mosala, mpe mingi ya bato oyo baza na mosala, basalaka mosala na bango moko.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Bato mibale na kati ya bato misato ya Venezuela oyo basalaka, basalaka na misala ya biro, moto moko na kati ya minei basalaka na industrie pe moto moko kati na mitano basalaka misala ya bilanga.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Mosala moko ya ntina mpona bato ya Venezuela eza essence, mpe mboka oyo etindaka yango na mikili mosusu, atako moto moko na kati ya nkama moko asalaka mosala ya essence.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Na ebandeli ya lipanda ya ekolo, mayele ya bilanga ya botaniques ya Singapour esalisaki na kokomisa esanga engumba kitoko ya makasi.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Na 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, fololo orchidée hybride, baponaki yango po ezala fololo ya ekolo mobimba.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Mbula nyonso pene ya sanza ya zomi pene ya banyama 1,5 milio oyo eliaka matiti ekendaka na bisobe ya sudi, bakatisaka ebale Mara, longwa na bangomba ya nordi mpona kokima bambula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Na nsima kozonga na nordi koleka na weste, kokatisa lisusu ebale Mara, nsima ya bambula ya sanza ya minei.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Etuka ya Serengeti ezali na parke nationale ya Serengeti, esika babongaka biloko ya Ngorongoro pe esika babombaka banyama ya masuwa na Tanzanie et esika babombaka biloko ya Maasai Mara na Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Koyekola na kosalela media oyo esengaka bato basala eloko esengaka mayele mingi ya sika pe ya kala, esengeka mpe bisaleli ya ntina mingi na bakelasi oyo esengaka bato basala eloko (storyboard, kokotisa malaoba mpe kosala, kokoma malaoba, bongo na bongo)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Midele ebongi esengeka ete ondimisa lisusu makanisi na yo na oyo etali kosala media pe koyekola kokanisa na lolenge oyo eza lineaire te.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Midele ebongi esengeka ete ondimisa lisusu makanisi na yo na oyo etali kosala media mpe koyekola kokanisa na lolenge oyo eza nzela moko te.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Mpasi ya zoom ya camera eza ete eza mpasi na komona eloko pe motango ya batalatala oyo bazalaka na yango mposa mpona molai ya esika oyo bakoki komona eleko eza mingi koleka mpona batalatala oyo eninganaka te.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Eza lisusu mokakatano te mpona bato basalaka maneti na kosala maneti ya kitoko mingi koleka.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Oyo esalisa ba zoom ya camera na kozwa bafoto ya kitoko oyo ekokani na bafoto oyo bazwaka na ba zoom oyo eninganaka te.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Likama mosusu ya miso ya zoom eza ete miso na yango efungwamaka (mbango) makasi mpenza te.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Yango esalaka ete ba zoom oyo ezalaka talo mingi eza mpasi na kosalela yango kozanga flashe na bisika oyo polele eza malamu te.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Moko ya mikatakatano ebimaki mingi soki olingi kobongola filme na DVD eza eloko babengaka surbalayage.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Basala ba televizio mingi na ndenge oyo esepelisaka bato oyo balandaka yango.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Mpona ntina wana, nyonso oyo omonaka na TV ezalaka na bandelo ya kokata, na likolo, na se pe na mipanzi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Basala yango po foto emonana na ecran mobimba. Babengaka yango surbalayage.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Eza mawa, ntango osolola DVD, basonge na yango pe ekokatana, pe soki osali video oyo eza na makomi ezoleka na ecran pene ya basonge, ekomonana te mobimba.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Ndako ya médiéval ya kala epesa bato makanisi mingi banda kala, epusa bango bakanisa bilili ya ba joutes, ya bafeti minene mpe ya bampunda ya arthurienne.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ata oza ya kotelema na kati ya bitika oyo esalaka bankoto ya bambula, eza pete na kokanisa makelele pe basolo ya bitumba oyo esila banda kala, na koyoka makelele ya basapatu likolo ya mabele mpe koyoka bobangi ezouta na mabulu ya donjon.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Kasi, makinisi na biso eutaka na makambo ya solo? mpona nini batongaki liboso bandako ya minene? Ndenge nini basalaka baplan na yango pe batongaki yango?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Ndenge ezalaki na kala, ndako kitoko ya Kirby Muxloe eza ndako ya makasi koleka ndako makasi ya solo.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Maninisa na yango ya minene ya talatala mpe bifelo na yango ya mike elingaki kobika te soki babundisaki yango na ntango molai.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Na mibu 1480, ntango babandaki kotonga yango na Lord Hastings, mboka ezalaki na mwa kimia mpe ezalaki kosenga kaka kobatela yango na mwa bituluku ya mike ya miyibi oyo bazalaki koya.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Bokatikati ya nguya eza ebongiseli oyo esalaka ete bikolo ya Eropa ebatela bokonzi ya etuka mokomoko oyo eza na Eropa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Likanisi ezalaki ete bikolo nyonso ya Eropa bakanga nzela po mboka moko te ekoma makasi mingi koleka basusu, yango wana mbala mingi biyangeli ya bamboka ezalaki kobongola boyakani na bango mpona kobatela bokatikati wana.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Bitumba ya kokitana ya Espagne ezalaki bitumba ya liboso oyo likambo bazalaki kowela ezalaki kokabola bokonzi.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Ezalaki mbongwana monene, mpo bakonzi ya Eropa balingaki kokosa lisusu te ete bazobunda bitumba mpona losambo. Yango wana, bitumba ya Mibu Tuku Misato ezalaki bitumba ya suka oyo babengaki ya losambo.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Babomaki tempelo ya Artemisi na Efezo na mokolo ya 21 sanza ya nsambo 356 liboso ya ntango na biso, moto oyo Herostratus atiaki, ezalaki mbeba monene.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Na kolanda lisolo wana, azalaki na mposa makasi ya lokumu. Bato ya Efezo, basilikaki, balobaki ete bakokoma lisusu te nkombo ya Herostratus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Na nsima moto ya istware ya Grese Strabo akomaki nkombo, ndenge toyebeli yango lelo. Babomaki tempelo na butu oyo Elexandre monene abotamaki.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, oyo azalaki mokonzi, alobaki akopesa mbongo mpo batonga lisusu tempelo, kasi baboyaki yango. Na nsima, nsima ya liwa ya Alexandre batongaki lisusu tempelo na mbula 323 Liboso ya Bantango na Biso.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Sala nyonso liboko na yo ezala malamu soki likoki ezali ntango ozokoma biloko nyonso malamu - lisusu komeka te na koningisa misapi na yo na makasi.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Na ndenge wana, ozali komilembisa yo moko mwa moke. Kobosana te, ntina na ntina te ya kobeta bilembo makasi mingi mpo makelele eza mingi neti na piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Na accordéon, mpona kozwa volime mosusu, okosalela eloko babengi soufflet makasi to na vitese mingi.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mysticisme eza koluka kozala na boyokani na, kokokana na, to koyeba likambo moko, nzambe moko, solo moko ya elimo, to Nzambe.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Mondimi alukaka komona makambo ye moko, likanisi moko boye, to bwania ya makambo ya nzambe ya mobali/ya mwasi to ya banzambe.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Bandimi balandaka lolenge moko boye ya bomoi to bizaleli oyo esalisaka na kokokisa mikano na ye.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mysticisme ekoki kokesena na bindimeli mpe losambo mosusu ya mangomba na ndenge na yango ya kolandela makambo etali komiyeba, mingimingi oyo etali kozala na kimia, bwania, to kutu kozala na esengo mingi.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisme eza lingomo moko ya kontina moke ya Inde. Ebandaki na etuka ya Pendjab na ekeke ya 15 na bokabwani oyo esalemaki na lingomba ya Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Bato ya Shikhs bamonaka bindimeli na bango ete ekabwana na ya lingomba ya Hindu atako bandimaka ete euta na Hindu pe balandaka mimeseno na yango.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Bato ya Sikhs babengaka lingomba na bango Gurmat, oyo na Punjabi elimboli "nzela ya guru". Guru eza likambo ya ntina mingi mpona bangomba nyonso ya Inde kasi na Sikhisme eza ndimbola oyo esala ete ezala moboko ya bindimeli na bango.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Basalaki lingomba wana na ekeke ya 15 na Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Eza na baguru libwa oyo balandanaki moko nsima ya mosusu.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Kasi na sanza ya motoba 1956, bilaka ya Krouchtchev emekamaki ntango bato basalaki mobulu na Pologne, wana bato ya mosala batombokaki mpona bilei bazalaki kopesa bango mpe bakitisaki salere na bango, yango ekomaki botomboki ya makasi na boyangeli ya bakoministe.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Atako na suka, Krushchev atindaki bashare mpona kotia molongo, andimaki makambo mosusu ya nkita oyo basengaki ye pe andimaki kotia Wladyslaw Gomulka oyo ayebanaki mingi lokola premier ministre ya sika.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Lisanga ya bato ya lobwaku ya Indus ezalaki lisanga ya brnze na nordi weste ya kontina moke ya Inde, ezalaki kozwa eteni monene ya Pakistan ya lelo mpe biteni mosusu ya nordi weste ya Inde mpe nordi este ya Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Bokonzi wana ezalaka ya malamu na se ya Ebale Indus esika ezwa nkombo na yango.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Atako bato mosusu ya mayele bakanisaka ete lokola civilisation ezalaki mpe na pembeni ya bisika bikauka ya Ebale Sarasvati, esengeli mpenza babenga yango Civilisation ya Indus-Sarasvati, atako bato mosusu babengaka yango civilisation ya Harappan na kolanda nkombo ya Harappa, nkombo ya esika na yango ya liboso oyo babimisa na mabele na 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ndenge bokonzi ya Roma ezalaki kotia likebi mingi na mosala ya kisoda esalisaki na kokolisa makambo ya kimonganga.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Mokonzi Auguste abandaki kozwa minganga mpe kutu asalaki etuluku ya liboso ya minganga ya Roma mpona basalela bango nsima ya bitumba.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Minganga basalaka lipaso bayebi bakisi mingi oyo elalisaka, ata pe ba morphine oyo na bambuma ya pavot mpe bascopolamine ya bambuma ya herbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Bayebaki malamu kokata makolo mpona kobikisa bato ya maladi na maladi ya gangrène pe na garrots pe na mabanga oyo ekangaka makila nzela na kotambola.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Na bikeke mingi, bokonzi ya Roma ememaki matomba mingi na makambo ya kimonganga pe ebimisaki mayele mingi oyo toyebi lelo.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami Pureland eza origami moko oyo eza na bipekiseli oyo kaka bakoki kokanga kaka lizita moko na mbala moko, mazita ya mpasi neti mazita oyo ebaluka epesami te ndingisa pe mazita mingi ezalaka na bisika ya pete.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: John Smith moto asalaki yango na mibu 1970 mpona kosalisa bato bayebi mosala malamu to bayebi mpenza te kosala muvema na misisa.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bana bakolisaka mayele ya koyeba baposo ya nzoto pe baposo ya nzoto ekeseni ntango baza naino mike pe yango ezalaka na bopusi na bizaleli na bango.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Na ndakisa, bana oyo balingaki mingi bato ya poso oyo baza mingi te oyo bato bamonaka ete bazalaka mayele te na kelase to bazalaka mayele na kelasi soki bayebi makambo etali poso ya nzoto na bango.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace eza site internet ya misato eyebana mingi oyo basalelaka na Etats-Unis mpe sikoyo eza na bato bamilio 54.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Basite internet wana bato bazotiela yango likebi mingi, mingimingi mpona koyekola.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Eza na makambo ya malamu na basite internet wana, na ndakisa kozala na likoki ya kobongisa lokasa ya ebandeli na pete, ekoki kozala na ba blog, bavideo, bafoto, pe biloko mosusu.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Okoki kokoma kozanga mpasi na lokasa wana kaka soki opesi adrese moko, esalaka ete ezala pete na kobosana yango te pe pete na kokoma po bana-kelasi oyo mbala mosusu baza na mikakatano na kosalela clavier to na ndenge ya kokoma malamu.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Ekoki kozala bongisa yango mpo eza pete na kotanga mpe ekoki kozala na couleur mingi to moke ndenge olingi.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Maladi ya kozonga kotia likebi "eza maladi ya boongo oyo bilembo na yango mingi ya makasi eza kozala kanda-kanda, kozanga kotia likebi pe kozala na makasi mingi mpenza".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Eza te ebosono ya koyekola, eza maladi ya koyekola; "bana 3 kino 5 na kati ya mokama babelaka yango, mbala mosusu bana ya Amerika pene ya bamilio 2".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bana oyo babelaka TDA bakokaka te kotia makanisi esika moko na makambo neti misala ya kelasi, kasi batiaka makanisi esika moko na makambo basepelaka na yango na ndakisa kosakana to kotala badessin anime oyo balingaka mingi to kokoma ba phrase kozanga kosalela bilembo ya kopema.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bana wana balingaka komilukela makambo mingi, mpo "bazalaka na bizaleli ya mabe, babundaka, mpe batosaka te bokonzi" mpona koningisa boongo na bango, mpo bakoki te kopusa boongo na bango esala na ndenge ya malamu.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD ezalaka na bopusi na baninga mosusu mpo bana mosusu bayebaka te mpona nini basalaka makambo ndenge basalaka yango to mpona nani balobaka ndenge balobaka to bokoli na bango ekeseni.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Lokola makoki ya kozwa boyebi pe koyekola ebongwani na ndenge oyo tolobeli likolo, ndenge oyo bato bazalaki kozwa mayele ebongwanaki.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Mayele ya kozwa basang ekesenaki. Bopusi ezalaki te na kobengisa bato, kasi mayele ya kokanisa maloba ekomaki ntina mingi koleka.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Na mokuse, kobotama lisusu esalaki mbongwana monene na lolenge ya koyekola mpe ya kopanza boyebi.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Na bokeseni na ba primates mosusu, ba hominidés basalelaka te maboko na bango mpona kotambola to komema kilo to kodiembela na banzete.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Liboko na likolo ya munkomboso eza molai mpe monene ndenge moko, ezomonisa ete asalelaka maboko mpona komema bakilo ntango azotambola.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Loboko ya moto eza mokuse koleka lokolo, ezalaka na phalanges ya semba.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Mikwa ya kala oyo esa bambula bamilio mibale to bamilio misato emonisaki bokeseni wana na ndenge ya kosalela yango.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Bato mosusu bakanisaka ete mbala mingi, kolota bandoto ebele ya malamu, yango moko ekoki mpe kolembisa mingi.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Ntina monene oyo likambo wana esalemaka ezali bandolo ya solo oyo ebakisaka molai ya ngonga kati na REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Lokola eza na ba REM moke na butu, ntango wana oyo oyokaki mpenza pongi pe nzoto na yo ezwaka lisusu makasi, ekomaka mike pe ekomaka mokakatano.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Elembisaka mingi neti ezosenga olamuka mbala nyonso nsima ya miniti tuku mibale to misato mpe kotala TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Makambo wana etaleli mbala boni boongo na yo esalaka makasi na kolota bandoto ya malamu na butu.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Makambo etambolaki malamu te po bato ya Italie na Afrika ya nordi kaka banda na ebandeli. Poso moko nsima wana Italie elobaki ete bitumba ebanda na mokolo ya 10, 1940, nsima ya po Hussars 11 ya Grande-Bretagne ebotolaki Fort Capuzzo na Libye.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Na motambo batielaka bato na este ya Bardia, bato ya Grande Bretagne bakangaki ingénieur mokonzi ya etuluku ya zomi ya basoda ya Italie, general Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Na mokolo ya 28 sanza ya motoba, Marshal Italo Balbo, Guvernere monene ya Lybie mpe mokitani ya Mussolini, babomaki ye na masisi ya moninga moko ntango azalaki kokita na Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Masano ya lelo ya 'escrime babetaka yango na banivo mingi, banda na bana-kelasi oyo bazotanga na universite kino na bato bayebi yango malamu pe na komemaka ya Olympique.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Babetaka lisano wana bato mibale, moko azobunda na mosusu.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golfe eza lisano oyo basani basalelaka banzete mpona kokotisa babalon na mabulu.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Bazalaka na mposa ya mabulu zomi na mwambe mpona lisano nyonso, mbala mingi basani babandaka na libulu ya liboso pe basukisaka na libublu ya zomi na mwambe.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Joueur oyo abetaka banzete moko to oyo asalelaka diemba mingi, to mpona kosilisa pe kolonga.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Lisano wana ebetamaka na matiti, pe matiti ya zingazinga ya libulu bakataka yango mpo ezala mokuse pe babengaka yango green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Mbala mosusu lolenge ya kokende kotala bisika oyo eyebani eza oyo bato mingi bayokanisaka na kosala mobembo: kokende kotala bisika mpona kozwa mopepe.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Oyo eza ntango bato bakendaka esika moko oyo ekeseni mpenza na bomoi na bango ya mokolo na mokolo mpona kolekisa ntango pe kosepela.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Mabongo, baparke ya kitoko pe bisika ya esobe ya kokende kofanda ezalaka mbala mingi bisika oyo bato bakendaka kotala bamboka ya bapaya bakendaka kolekisa ngonga.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Soki mokano oyo moto moko azokende kotala esika moko eza ya koyeba lisolo mpe bokoko na yango wana babengaka yango kokende kotala esika mpona koyeba bokoko.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Bata oyo bayaka kotala bakoki kotala bisika ekeseni na mboka moko boye to bakoki kopona kotia likebi kaka na esika moko.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Babotoli, mpo bamonaki mosala wana, babengaki pe basoda mosusu mpona kosalisa bango.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Bato ya Stark bazwaki bisika pene ya lopango na suka ya nordi ya esika ya babotoli mboka.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: ntango mai ya makasi efungoli nzela na Ebale Mystic na ndelo ya nordi este ya esanga, bakomisaki noki bandelo na bango molai na mwa efelo ya mabanga ya mokuse na nordi oyo ezosuka na mopanzi ya mai na mwa libongo ya moke.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Miango ya bato ya Amerika esimbamaki na kobundisa eloko banda na bisika misato ekeseni.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General John Cadwalder akomema basoda mpona kobundisa basoda ya Grande Bretange na Bordentown, mpona kokanga nzela basalisa bango te ata moke.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Lokola balongwaki na quart ya mbangu mpe bakomaki na demi-mile, vitese ekomaki ntina mingi te mpe kokanga motema ekomaki ntina mingi.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Ya solo, katikati ya kilometele mpona kelasi ya liboso, moto oyo akoki kolonga miniti mibale, asengeli kozala na vitese ya malamu, kasi asengeli kolona ezaleli ya kokanga motema na makama nyonso.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Kopota mwa mbangu ya cross-country na eleko ya malili, elongo na ngalasisi ya biteni ya likolo ya nzoto, eza lolenge ya malamu koleka ya komibongisa na mbangu ya mbula mobimba.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Mayele mebongi ya koleisa bato yango moko ekoki te mpona kosalisa malamu, kasi ekoki kozala na bopusi mingi na bolamu ya ba athlete mingi ya bilenge.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kozala na nzoto kolongono ya malamu, koyeba kobatela mai na nzoto, mpe koyeba makambo ndenge na ndenge ekoki kosalisa basani na komatisa makoki na bango mpe kosalisa bango na kosepela mingi na masano na bango.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Ekoki kosomba biloko soki olingi, kasi mingi ekosalisa moke to mingi te na mosala.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Baathlètes bakoki kokanisa balingaka eloko moko ata soki eza te na matomba ya solo.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Tokoki koloba ete atome eza moko ya biloko ya ntina mingi mpona biloko nyonso.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Eza likambo ya mpasi mingi, oyo na kolanda modele moko ya pete ya Bohr, eza na mokokoli eza na katikati oyo ba electron eza zingazinga na yango, ekokani moke na baplanete oyo ezalaka zingazinga ya moi - tala Elilingi 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Noyau ezalaka na biteni mibale - baneutron na baproton.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Baproton ezalaka na courant ya malamu kasi ba neutron ezalaka te na courant. Baelectron ezalaka na courant ya mabe.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Mpona kolandela moto azwi mpasi, osengeli naino kotalela sika wana mpona koyeba soki eza na libateli.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Osengeli koyeba ndenge moto wana azali ntango ozopusana pene na ye mpe elembo nyonso ya drapo ya motane.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Soki omisali mpasi ntango ozali komisalisa, okoki kutu komisala mabe makasi.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Bolukiluki emonisi ete koniokwama na makasi, kobanga pe minioko ekotaka na boyokani kati na mpasi na ebosono ya moto oyo abelaka mpasi ya mukongo.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Kaka nde bopusi ya makama makasi, kasi te koniokwama na makanisi na bobangi nde eutaki na misala oyo bazalaki kosala poso nyonso mpona kobongisa PA.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Bato oyo basalaka misala mbala na mbala baza na mposa ya lisungi mingi na oyo etali lolenge ya mabe ya kotalela mpasi, kosala bokeseni na kati ya mpasi esilaka te na koyoka mwa mabe mpona eloko moko oyo osali.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Emonaneli, to makoki ya komona etalelaka bianama ya komona to miso.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Eza na biloko mingi oyo ekeseni na miso, oyo mpasi na yango ezalaka na kolanda masengami ya eloko moko.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Bandako ekeseni eza na makoki ya kokesena, ezolandela bokeseni ya molai ya ba onde pe eza na ba degre ekeseni, lisusu ezosenga mayele mosusu to ezala malamu pe ezosenga mintango ekeseni po esala malamu.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Population eza lisanga ya bikelamu ya lolenge moko oyo efandaka na esika moko boye.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Soki bato nyonso ya mboka moko baza ndenge moko na oyo etali elobeli na bango, babengaka bango bamonomorphes.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Soki bato mingi bamonisi lolenge mingi ekeseni ya ezaleli moko bablobaka bazali polymorphes.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Libota ya bafourmis etambolaka pe etongaka bandako na yango malembe-malembe.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Ntango bakendaka esika mosusu, bitululu ya bafourmis batambolaka na butu mpe basalaka camp na moi mpo batambola te.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Lisanga ebandaki kokende esika mosusu soki bilei ezalaki lisusu mingi te esika bazalaki. Na ntango wana, lisanga ezalaki kosala bandako ya ango moke oyo bazalaki kobongola mikolo nyonso.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Mokomoko ya mibembo to kotambola wana ezalaki kozwa pene ya mikolo 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Selile eza nini? Liloba wana euti na liloba ya Latin "cella", oyo elimboli "chambre ya moke", ebimisamaki na moto moko oyo asalaki microscope, ntango amonaki nzoto ya liège.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Selile eza eloko ya ntina na biloko nyonso eza na bomoi, pe biloko nioso eza na selile moko to ebele.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Baselile eza na ntina mingi mpenza na boyekoli ya bomoi, yango wana babengaka yango mbala mingi "biloko esalisa na kotonga bomoi".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Boongo na biso ebatelaka homéostasie ndenge etindaka basango na bansinga ya boongo na nzoto mpona makila ekoba kotambola pe etambola malamu.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Bopusi oyo ya boongo ekoki kotindama noki na nzoto, esalisaka na kobatela nzoto na likama oyo ekoki kobima.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Mpela ebetaki na esika moko soki tokokanisi yango na mipepe misusu ya makasi, kasi ekoki koboma biloko nyonso na nzela ntango ezoleka.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Mpela etumolaka banzete, elongolaka mabaya na bandako, ememaka mituka na likolo. Mpela mibale ya koleka makasi na kati ya mokanda esalaka bangonga koleka misato.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Mipepe wana ya mabe ekoki kokoma kino na 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Bato basalaka pe basalelaka maneti mpona kokoma kitoko banda bambula mingi mpenza.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Kasi, telescope ya liboso ya solo esalemaki na Eropa na suka ya ekeke ya 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Batelescope oyo esalelaki maneti mibale mpo kosala ete biloko oyo eza mosika emonana eza pembeni mpe eza minene.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Lokoso na moimi ekozalaka ntango nioso elongo na biso pe boyokani eza ete ntango bato mingi bazweli yango matomba ekozala na makambo mingi ya kozwa nsima ya ntango mokie soki toza na moimi.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Nazolikia, bato mingi bakoyeba ete liponi na bango ya malamu ya ntango molai eza ya kosala elongo na basusu.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Bato ebele balotaka mokolo oyo bato bakoki kosala mobembo na monzoto mosusu pe komona mikili mosusu, bato mosusu bamitunaka nini eza kuna, basusu bakanisaka bapaya to bikelamu mosusu efandaka na planete mosusu.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Kasi, soki esalemi mpenza mbala mosusu ekozwa ngonga mingi te. Minzoto eza ya kopanzana mpenza kuna yango wana eza na bamiliare ya bakilometele oyo ekabolaka minzoto oyo ezalaka "pembeni".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mbala mosusu mokolo ezali, bana ya bakoko na yo bakobima na mokili bayebi te bazali komituna banani baza bakoko na bango ya kala?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Banyama ezalaka na baselile mingi. Baliaka biloko mpe baliaka yango lisusu na kati. Banyama mingi etambolaka.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Banyama pamba eza na boongo (atako banyama nyonso te nde baza na yango; na ndakisa, méduse, eza te na boongo).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Banyama ezalaka bisika nyonso na mabele. Batimolaka mabele, batambolaka na bambu, pe bapumbwaka likolo.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Selile eza eloko ya moke koleka mpe oyo esalaka, oyo ezalaka na kati ya bikelamu (biloko) eza na bomoi.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Selile euta na liloba ya Kilatini cella oyo elimboli chambre ya moke.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Soki otali bikelamu ya bomoi na microscope, okomona ete esalema na biloko ya mike-mike.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, moto ya biologie ya Angleterre, amonaki ba carrés ya mike na microscope na liège.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Ezalaki neti bachambre. Azalaki moto ya liboso oyo amonaki baselile ya kokufa
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Biloko pe biteni ekoki kolongwa na etuka moko pe kokende na etuka mosusu kozanga ebongwana.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Azote lokola eza gaz to mopepe eza na biloko nyonso oyo ezala na azote ya mai. Soki eza mai ezalaka ya kokangama kasi bamolecule ezalaka kaka ndenge moko.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Mai eza ndakisa mosusu. Mai esalemi na baatome mibale ya hydrgene mpe atome moko ya oxygene.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Ezalaka ndenge moko na mipepe, mai, to biloko ya makasi.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Atako nzoto na yango ekoki kobongwana, ezaleli na yango ebongwanaka te.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: ntango eza eloko oyo ezalaka zingazinga na biso, pe ezalaka na bopusi na eloko nyonso tosala, kasi eza mpasi na koyeba yango.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Bato ya mayele ya makambo ya losambo, ya filozofi, pe ya siansi bayekola ntango bankoto ya bambula eleki.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: ntango elekelaka biso lokola makambo elandani ezoleka banda na mikolo eza oyo koleka na lelo pe na ntango ya kala.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: ntango eza pe ndenge tokokanisaka ntango (molai) oyo makamabo esali.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Okoki kotia yo moko bilembo na ndenge ntango ezoleka na kotanga ba repetition ya likambo moko oyo ezongaka. Likambo ezongaka eza likambo oyo esalemaka mbala na mbala.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Basalelaka ba ordinatere lelo mpona kobongisa bafoto na bavideo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Biloko ezoningana ya mindondomindondo bakoki kosala yango na baordinatere, mpe biloko ya lolenge wana, bakomi kosalela yango mingi na televizio mpe na bafilme.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Mbala mingi basalaka enregistrement ya miziki na nzela ya ba ordinatere ya mindondomindondo mpona kobongisa mpe kosangisa mingongo.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Banda kala na ekeke ya zomi na libwa mpe tuku mibale, bato bazalaki kokanisa ete bato ya liboso oyo bafandaki na Nouvelle-Zélande ezalaki baMaoris, oyo bazalaki kosala bokila ya bandeke ya minene ebengami moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: na nsima bandimaki makanisi oyo elobaka ete bato ya Maori bautaki na Polynésie na masuwa moko ya monene mpe babotolaki Nouvelle-Zélande na maboko ya ba Moriori, basalaki lisanga ya basali-bilanga.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Kasi, bilembeteli ya sika emonisi ete Moriori ezalaki etuluku oyo ezalaka na mabele ya Maori oyo balongwaki na Nouvelle-Zélande mpe bakendaki na bisanga ya Chatham, bakolisaka lolenge na bango moko ya bomoi ya kimya.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ezalaki na ekolo mosusu na bisanga ya Chatham, ezalaki ba Maori oyo bayaki wana longwa na Nouvelle-Zelande.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Bamibengaka bango moko ba Moriori po ezalaki na mwa bitumba kuna kasi na suka, basilisaki ba Moriori.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Bato oyo bamipesa banda bambula mingi basalisaki biso na koyeba makasi na biso mpe makambo tolingaka, balobelaka na bosolo mikakatano mpe bisika tolonga te.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: ntango ozoyoka bato bazolobela masolo na bango, ya libota na bango mpe ya lisanga na bango, toyebaka makambo mingi bakutana na yango na mikolo eleki mpe bato mosusu oyo bazalaka na bopusi ya malamu to ya mabe na mimeseno ya lisanga wana.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Ata koyeba lisolo ya bomoi ya moto elakisi te koyeba mimeseno na ye, esalisaka na koyeba ata mpona koyeba esika moto yango azali na lisolo ya lisanga wana.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: ntango ozotalela kolonga mpe koyeba kozanga kolonga, bato bango moko mpe bato nyonso oyo bazosangana bayebaki malamu bizaleli, mosala, mpe makambo etambwisaka lisanga moko.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Na likambo ya boye, kokundwela bizaleli ya kala ya kokamba mosala pe bolongi oyo bazwaki esalisaka bato na kosala mbongwana ya sika mpe nzela ya sika na lingomba ya mboka.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Masolo wana ya kolonga ekitisaka bobangi ya mbongwana, ebimisaka mpe makanisi malamu mpona mbongwana ekosalema na mikolo ezoya.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Ndenge ya kokanisa eza mayele ya kobongisa makambo oyo esangisaka makanisi mingi to makoki mingi mpona kobongisa likambo.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Mokano na yango ezalaki vitese, molongo, mpe bosikisiki, mpe koyeba makambo ya solo, kosalela lisusu mayele ya kala ya kosangisa basango.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Likambo eleki ntina na makanisi oyo eza: eyano ya solo eza kaka moko. Okokanisa kaka biyan mibale, solo to lokuta.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Makanisi ya ndenge wana ezalaka na boyokani na siansi moko boye to miango eyebana.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Bato oyo bakanisaka ndenge wana bakanisaka malamu, bakoki kokanga makambo na moto, kobongisa makambo mpe kosala ba ekzame ya siansi.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Bato baza bikelamu ya mayele mpenza na oyo etali kotanga makanisi ya basusu.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Elimboli ete tokoki kolonga koyeba liboso makambo yo bato mosusu bakoki komona, kokanisa, kondima, koyeba to kolinga.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Na kati ya makoki oyo, koyeba makanisi ya basusu eza ntina mingi. Esalisaka na koyeba mikakatano ya misala na bango.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Na ndakisa, soki omoni moto moko azopasola talatala ya motuka moko, bokokanisa ete azoluka koyiba motuka ya bato.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Esengaki ete basambisi ye ndenge mosusu soki abungisaki bafungola ya motuka na ye moko pe azalaki nde koluka kokota kati na motuka na ye moko.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Ekzame IRM esalemaka na kolanda likambo moko ya physique oyo babengaka résonance magnétique nucléaire (RMN), oyo babimisaki na mibu 1930 na Felix Bloch (oyo asalaka na Université ya Stanford) pe Edward Purcell (ya Université ya Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Na likambo wana, etando ya bibende ebendaka (champ magnétique) na mbonge ya radio esalaka ete baatomes ebimisa mwa basignale ya radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.
