text: Na mbula 1970, Raymond Damadian, monganga mpe molukiluki ya makambo ya siansi, amonaki bantina ya kosalela bilili na résonance magnétique mpona koyeba maladi.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Mibu minei na nsima, bapesaki diplome, oyo ezalaki diplome ya liboso oyo bapesaki na makambo ya IRM.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Na 1977, monganga Damadian asilisaki kosala scanner IRM ya liboso ya "nzoto mobimba," apesaki yango nkombo "oyo bakoki kolonga te."
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kosolola ebengami asynchrone elendisaka kozwa ntango ya kokanisa pe ya koyoka basusu.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ezolakisa bana-kelasi makoki ya kosala na vitese na bango moko mpe ya kolanda vitese ya mateya epesamaka na kelasi.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Lisusu, eza na bipekiseli moke na likoki ya kobongola bangonga ya mosala. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kosalela Internet mpe site internet ya mokili mobimba esalisaka bayekoli na kozwa basango ntango nyonso.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Bana-kelasi bakoki kotindela balakisi mituna na bango na ntango nyonso na mokolo mpe kozela eyano ya noki, na esika ya kozala kaka kino ntango bakokutana miso na miso.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Mayele ya postmoderne ya koyekola epesaka bonsomi ya mobimba mpenza. Lolenge ya malamu ya koyekola ezali mingi.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Ya solo, eza malamu na koyekola. Koyekola esalemaka na boyokani kati na moyekoli mpe boyebi oyo bazopesa ye.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Mayele na biso ya sikoyo na basango nyonso oyo bazolakisa na televizio oyo euti na komekameka elakisa malamu likambo wana.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Bato mingi kati na biso balandaka bafilme oyo eyebisaka biso makambo to lolenge ya kosala makambo oyo tokotikalaka kosagana te to pe tokosalelaka mayele wana te.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Tokozongela te motuka na mobimba, kosala fontaine na nsima ndako na biso, kokende mobembo na Pérou mpona kotala bitika ya kala, to kobongisa ndako ya voisin na biso.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Na lisalisi na bansinga ya optique oyo batia na se ya mbu oyo esangisaka Eropa na satelite ya monene mpenza, Groenland eza mpenza connecté, 93% ya bato na yango bakotaka na Internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotel na yo to bato bayambi yo (soki ozofanda na hotel to na ndako ya bato) mbala mosusu ekozala na wifi to ordinatere oyo eza na internet, pe bisika nyonso eza na bisika ya internet to mwa bisika oyo eza na wifi ya bato nyonso.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Ndenge tolobeli yango na likolo, ata soki liloba "Eskimo" bakobaka kosalela yango na Etats-Unis, bato mingi ya Amerika te oyo bazalaka na Arctique, mingimingi na Canada, bamonaki yango liloba ya mabe.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Ata soki okoki koyoka bana-mboka ya Groenland bazosalela liloba wana, bapaya basengeli komeka te kosalela yango.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Bakolo-mboka ya Groenlande bamibengaka baInuits na Canada pe Kalaalleq (pluriel Kalaallit), moto ya Groenlande, na lokota ya Groenlande.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Koboma bato, pe makanisi mabe epai ya bapaya, eyebani mpenza te na Groenland. Ata na bamboka, ezalaka te na "bisika ya mpasi."
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Mopepe ya malili eza likama oyo mbala mosusu kaka bato oyo babongami te nde bakokutana na yango.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Soki okei kotala Groenland na bileko ya malili (yeba ete soki ozokoba kokende na nord, malili ekozala makasi koleka), eza ntina malamu komema biloko ya molunge.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Mikolo ya milai mingi na eleko ya molunge ekoki kobimisa mikakatano ya kolala mingi te pe maladi oyo yango ememaka.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Na eleko ya molunge, osengeli kokeba mpe na bangungi. Atako bapesaka maladi te, bakoki kopesa yo nkanda.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Atako nkita ya San Franciso eza na boyokani na ndenge ebendaka bapaya mingi ya mokili mobimba, mbongo eutaka na bisika mingi.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Misala oyo ezalaka na bato mingi mpenza ezali misala ya makasi, guvernema, nkita, mombongo, mpe kokenda kotala bamboka ya bapaya.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ndenge balakisaka yango mbala mingi na miziki, na bafilme, na babuku mpe na makambo ya bokoko esalisa mpo engumba mpe bamonima na yango eyebana na mokili mobimba.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco asala bisika ya kitoko mingi mpona bapaya bayaka kotala bamboka; basala bahotel, malewa mpe bisika ya kitoko makasi.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco eza mpe moko ya bisika ya kitoko mingi ya mboka mpona bilei mosusu ya Asie: ya Corée, ya Thaïlande, ya Inde, mpe ya Japon.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kosala mobembo na Walt Disney World ezali mobembo ya monene mpona mabota mingi ya Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Visiti "ya malamu" esengaka kozwa mpempona Aeroport international ya Orlando, kokende na hotel Disney na bisi, kolekisa pene ya poso moko kozanga kolongwa na lopango ya Disney, pe kozonga na ndako.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Eza na maponi ebele mpenza, kasi oyo eza oyo bato mingi balobaki ntango balobelaka "kokende na mokili ya Disney".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Batike ebele oyo batekaka na internet na nzela ya basite internet eBay to Craigslist eza batike ya mikolo ebele oyo basalela mwa moke.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Atako eza mosala oyo esalemaka mingi, epekisami na Disney: okoki te kopesa batike na moto mosusu.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kofanda nyonso na nse pene ya Grand Canyon esengaka kozwa liboso ndingisa na mboka.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Batiaka ndelo na ndingisa mpona kobatela canyon mpe ebimaki na mokolo ya 1 ya sanza, basanza minei liboso ya sanza ya ebandeli.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Yango wana, ndingisa ya kotonga na bamboka ya date nyonso oyo ebandi na sanza ya mitano ekomonana banda mokolo ya 1 sanza ya yambo.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Bisika ya pamba na bisika mingi ya bato mingi, na ndakisa Bright Angel Campground adjacent na Phantom Ranch, mbala mingi etondaka na bademande oyo bazwaka na date ya liboso oyo bafungolaka po bato bakanga bisika.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Eza na mantango moke ya bandingisa babongisa mpona bosengi kozanga kokanga esika liboso na kolanda mobeko bakopesa naino na moto ayei liboso.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kokota na motuka na Afrika ya sud eza lolenge ya kitoko ya komona kitoko ya bituka nyonso mpe ya kokende na bisika oyo bato bakendaka kotala mboka-mopaya bakomaka te.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Ekoki kosalema na motuka oyo babongisaka malamu kasi eza malamu mingi kosalela motuka 4x4 pe okoki kokoma na bisika mosusu kaka soki okei na bapneu ya likolo ya 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Kobosana te ntango ozobongama ete atako Afrika ya sudi eza malamu kasi bamboka nyonso ya zingazinga eza bongo te.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Masengami mpe talo ya viza ekeseni na kolanda mboka mokomoko mpe etalaka mboka oyo outi.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ekolo na ekolo eza na mibeko na yango na oyo etali biloko ya kosalela na mbalakaka oyo esengeli kozala na kati ya motuka.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls eza engumba moko na weste ya mboka Zimbabwe, soki oleki ndelo ya Livingstone, Zambie pe pene ya Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Mboka eza mpenza pene ya balobwaku, mpe yango nde ebendaka bato mingi, kasi esika oyo bapaya bayaka kotala epesaka bato oyo balingaka maseki pe bato oyo bayaka kotala mabaku ebele ya kolekisa mikolo mingi.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Na eleko ya mbula (sanza ya zomi na moko kino na sanza ya misato), mai ezalaka mingi mpe balobwaku ekozala makasi.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Okozanga te kopola soki okatisi gbagba otamboli na banzela oyo ezala pene ya lobwaku wana.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Na ndambo mosusu, eza mpenza po mai ezalaka likolo mingi yango wana okoki komona te malamu Balobwaku—mpona mai nyonso wana!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Nkunda ya Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 ekoki kozala nkunda ya lokumu mingi na bankunda nyonso ya lobwaku wana, mpona 1922 Howard Carter emonaka nkunga ya mokonzi ya elenge eza mpenza kaka ndenge ezalaki.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kasi, soki tokokanisi yango na bankunda mingi ya bakonzi, nkunda ya Toutankhamon ebongi mpenza kokende kotala yango, mpo eza moko mpe bakomisa yango mpenza kitoko.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Moto nyonso alingi komona bilembeteli ya ndenge babebisi ebembe bakausa ntango bazalaki koluka kobimisa yango na sanduku akolemba nzoto po kaka moto na mapeka nde ezomonana.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Bozwi ya mingi ya nkuda wana eza lisusu te na kati na yango, kasi balongola yango pe bamema yango na musée ya Egypte na Caire.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Bapaya oyo baza na ntango mingi te, ekozala malamu balekisa ntango na bango esika mosusu.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, eza an 12 km na sudi weste ya Siem Reap. Tempelo oyo eza na mawa ngomba batongaki yango na suka ya ekeke ya 9, na nse ya boyangeli ya mokonzi Yasovarma.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ndenge makambo ezalaki mabe na tempelo pe ndenge ezali komonana longwa na lac Tonlé Sap esalaka ete komata na mwa ngomba ezala kitoko.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Vizite ya esika wana bakoki mpenza kosangisa yango na mwa mobembo ya masuwa mpona kotala etima.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Esika ya koleka na Angkor eza ntina mingi mpona kokota na tempelo, yango wana kobosana te komema passeport na yo ntango ozokende na Tonlé Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yeruzalemi eza mboka ya monene koleka mpe mboka-mokonzi ya Israele, atako mikili mingi mosusu mpe Etats-Unis endimaka yango te lokola mboka-mokonzi ya Israele.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Engumba ya kala ya Yudea oyo ezalaka na ngomba moke eza na lisolo ya kitoko oyo ezolobela bankoto ya bambula.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Engumba eza mosantu mpona mangomba misato - Bayuda, Baklisto pe Bamizlma, mpe ezala esika ya monene ya elimo, ya losambo, mpe ya mimeseno ya kala.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Mpo engumba wana eza na ntina mingi na makambo ya Nzambe, mpe mingimingi mpona bisika mingi ya Engumba ya Kala, Yeruzaleme eza moko ya bisika oyo bato mingi oyo bakendaka kotala Yisalaele bakendaka kotala.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yeruzalemi eza na bisika ya kala oyo eza na masolo ya kala, biloko ya kala, bokoko mingi, eza mpe na bisika minene, bisika ya komela kafe mpe malewa ya minene esika bato mingi bayaka.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Équateur ezosenga ete bato ya Cuba bazwa mokanda ya libiangi liboso bakota na Équateur na nzela ya libanda ya mpepo ya mikili mingi to na bangambo mosusu ya kokotela na mikili.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ministre ya Equateur atalaka makambo ya bamboka bapaya asengeli kondima mokanda wana, pe kotosa mwa masengami.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Babimisaki masengami wana mpona bato ya mikili wana mibale batombola ndenge ebongi kozaga mobulu.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Bato ya Cuba oyo baza na carte verte ya Amerika basengeli kokende na consulat ya Equateur mpo apesa bango ndingisa ya kozala te na eloko wana.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Passeport na yo esengeli kozala na ngala mpona basanza ata 6 koleka badate ya mobembo na yo. Osengeli kozala na tike ya kokende/kozonga mpona kondimisa mikolo oyo okosala kuna.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Baviziti ezalaka talo moke mpona bituluku ya miene, yango wana soki oza yo moko to kaka na moninga moko, meka kokutana na bato mosusu mpe bosala etuluku ya bato minei to motoba mpo bafuta mbongo mingi te.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Kasi, esengeli mpenza kotungisa yo, mpo mbala mingi bato bakendaka kotala mboka bapaya bazwaka bango mpona kotondisa mituka.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Ezomonana ete eza mpenza lolenge ya kokosa bato na kokanisa ete basengeli kopesa mbongo mingi.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ngomba oyo ezalaka likolo na suka ya nordi ya Machu Picchu mbala mingi ezoleka na nsima ya bafoto mingi ya bitika oyo.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Ebangisaka soki otali yango na nse, mpe ekita makasi mpe mpasi na komata, kasi bato mingi oyo baza malamu bakoki kokoma kuna nsima ya miniti 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Batia mabongo ya kotambolela pene ya banzela mingi, mpe na bisika oyo mabulu eza mingi, bansinga ya acier ezalaka mpona kosimba na maboko.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Elingi koloba, mizela ete pema ekatana mpe keba na biteni ya mabe, mingimingi soki oza na mai, po ezokoma likama noki.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Eza na libulu ya moke pene ya likolo oyo basengeli koleka, eza na mwa se mpe pression eza mwa makasi.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Komona bisika zamba ya Galapagos ezalaka kitoko mingi na masuwa, kaka ndenge Charles Darwin asalaki na mobu 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Bamasuwa koleka 60 etambolaka na mai ya Galapagos - eza oyo ememaka bato 8 kino na bato 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bato ebele bakanga bisika na bango na liboso mpenza (mbala mingi masuwa ezalaka ya kotonda na eleko ya molai).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Luka koyeba soki mosali oyo ozokanga esika epai na ye aza moto ayebi malamu Galapagos mpe aza na boyebi mingi ya bololenge ekeseni ya masuwa.Luka koyeba soki mosali oyo ozokanga esika epai na ye aza moto ayebi malamu Galapagos mpe aza na boyebi mingi ya bololenge ekeseni ya masuwa.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Ekosalisa po makambo oyo olingaka mingi pe/to oyo olingaka te ekokana na masuwa oyo ebongi mpenza na bango.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Liboso Espagne ekoma na ekeke ya 16, nordi ya Chili ezalaki na nse ya boyangeli ya baInca mpe bana-mboka ya Araucanians (Mapuche) bazalaki kofanda na katikati pe na sudi ya Chili.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ezalaki mpe moto ya bitulu ya bakolo-mboka ya Amerika oyo bazwaki lipanda, oyo bamikotisaki mpenza na mibeko ya bato balobaka lokota ya Espagnol kino nsima ya lipanda ya Chilie.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Atako Chilie ezwaki lipanda na 1810 (na kati ya bitumba ya Napoléon oyo etikaki Espagne kozanga boyangeli na eleko ya mwa bambula), bolongaki mpenza bato ya Espagne kaka na 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: République dominicaine (na lokota ya espagnol: República Dominicana) eza mboka moko ya Caraïbes oyo ezwaki katikati ya este ya esanga ya Hispaniola, oyo ekabolaka yango na Haïti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Longola mabongo ya zelo ya pembe mpe ya kitoko ya bangomba, mboka wana eza na engumba ya kala mpenza ya Eropa na Amerika, sikoyo eza na kati ya Saint-Domingue.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Bato ya liboso bafandaki na esanga wana eza ba Taínos na Caribes. Caribes ezalaki mboka ya bato oyo balobaka lokota ya Arawakan oyo bayaki wana pene ya mobu 10 000 liboso ya ntango na biso.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Mwa bambula moke nsima ya koya ya bato ya Eropa oyo bayaki kotala bamboka, bato ya Espagne oyo babotolaki mbongo bakitisaki mingi mpenza talo ya ba Tainos.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Na kotalela Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Boyokani ya Inde) na mibu 1492 pe 1498, bato ya Espagne oyo balongaki babomaki ba Taínos pene ya 100 000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Batongaki esika wana mpona couvent moko ya ekeke ya 17, kasi eloko etikali kino lelo oya ndako wana eza kaka Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Sikoyo ezosala lokola esika monene ya plaza, mpe mbala mingi ezalaka na misala mingi, na moi pe na butu.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Eza na malewa mingi zingazinga ya elanga, mpe na nsima ya midi mpe na bapokwa ezalaka na baconcert ya ofele oyo babetaka longwa na gazebo.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Mopesi Bizu). Bisika mibale ekabolama kaka na basentimetele 69 na ndako ya moto moko ya kala oyo ayebana mingi.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Soki opesi bango mbongo moke, bana mosusu bakobetela yo lisolo.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Esanga Bowen eza esika kitoko ya kokende na masuwa mokolo moko to na wikende; kuna okoki kosala kayak, kotambola, kosomba biloko na ba boutiques, kokende na malewa pe kosala makambo mingi mosusu.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Lisanga wana ya malamu ezalaka na Howe Sound pene ya Vancouver, pe okoki kokoma kuna kozanga mpasi na nzela ya bamasuwa oyo esalaka taxi oyo elongwaka esanga Granville na centre-ville ya Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Mpona baoyo balingaka kosala misala libanda, kotambola pene ya mbu to na sky eza ntina mingi.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (pene ya ngonga 1,5 na nzela ya Vancouver) eza talo mingi kasi eyebani mpona masano ya Olympique ya eleko ya mpio makasi ya 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Na eleko ya mpio makasi, sepela na ski ya malamu koleka ya Amerika ya Nord pe na eleko ya molunge meka kokende kotambola na velo na bangomba ya solo.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Esengaka kozwa ndingisa liboso. Osengeli kozala na ndingisa po olala na Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena eza esika moko pamba oyo babatela zamba oyo ezalaka na bachambre mingi ya kolala pe bilei ya moto pene ya ba camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo na Los Patos ezalaka na camping kasi ezalaka te na malewa.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Okoki kozwa ndingisa ya kokota na parke mbala moko na station Ranger na Puerto Jiménez, kasi bandimaka te bakarte ya nyongo
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Mosala ya parke (MINAE) epesaka mikanda ya baparke te koleka sanza moko liboso ya mokolo oyo bakoya.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ezopesa misala ya kobombela bato bisika na 30$, to na 10$ mpona kolekisa mokolo moko; makambo mingi eza la lokasa ya Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Bisanga Cook eza mokili ya kati ya esanga oyo eza na boyokani na bango moko na Nouvelle-Zélande, oyo eza na Polynésie, na katikati ya mbu ya Pacifique ya Sudi.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Eza esanga oyo esangisa bisanga 15 mpe eza na etando ya koleka bamilio 2,2 ya km2 ya mbu.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Lokola baza na ngonga moko na Hawaii, ntango mosusu bato bakanisaka ete bisanga wana "eza na se ya boyangeli ya Hawaii".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ata eza mike, ezokundwela biso bapaya ya mikolo oyo bayaki na Hawaii liboso mboka esalaema, tozalaki te na bahotel ya bapaya pe biloko mosusu ya kitoko.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Bisanga Cook eza te na engumba ata moko kasi eza na bisanga 15 ekeseni. Bisanga ya minene eza Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Na mikili ya bobola lelo, kozala na mbeto ya motuya mpe bilei ya ntongo ekoma neti makambo ya mayemi.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Na likolo ya nyonso, eza polele ete B&Bs bamekanaka na biloko mibale ya ntina: bilamba ya bambeto pe bilei ya ntongo.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Yango wana, na bisika ya malamu mingi ya lolenge oyo, tosengeli kozala na badrap ya malamu mpenza, mbala mosusu oyo basala bango moko to bambeto ya kala.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Bilei ya ntongo ekoki kozala na bilei ya kitoko ya etuka wana to bilei oyo mopaya alingaka mingi.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Esika oyo ekoki kozala ndako ya kitoko ya kala oyo eza na biloko ya kala, bilanga ya kikoto pe piscine.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kokota na motuka na yo moko mpe kobanda mobembo ya molai eza kitoko mingi mpona kosala makambo na pete.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Na kokesena na mituka ya minene, mbala mosusu osi omesana kokumba motuka na yo pe oyebi bandelo na yango.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kotia tenta na lopango na yo moko to na mboka moko na monene nyonso ekoki kobenda likebi kozanga ntina.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Na mokuse, kosalela motuka eza lolenge malamu ya kokende na mobembo kasi eza mpenza te nzela ya komema na "kaa".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Camping ya motuka esalemaka soki oza na fourgonnette mingi, SUV moko, berline moko to kopema na bakiti oyo elalisaka.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Bahotel misusu eza libula euta na eleko ya wolo ya banzela ya mabende mpe ya mbu; liboso ya bitumba ya mibale ya mokili mobimba, na ekeke ya 19 to na ebandeli ya ekeke ya 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Bahotel ezalaki bisika oyo bazwi na bato ya lokumu bazalaki kofanda, mpe mbala mingi ezalaki na bilei kitoko mpe bomoi malamu na butu.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Midele ya kala, modele ya kozanga biloko euti kobima sika, pe mwa mibange ya bonzenga baza pe na bato oyo basangani.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Atako mbala mingi ezalaka ya bato, ntango mosusu eyambaka bakonzi ya bamboka pe bato mosusu ya lokumu.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Mosali mobembo aza na mbongo mingi akoki kokanisa kosala mobembo na mpepo na mokili mobimba, mpe kotelema na mwa bisika mpona kolekisa ntango na ebele ya bahotel oyo.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Lisanga ya boyambi eza lisanga oyo esangisaka bato bazosala mobembo na bana mboka na bingumba oyo bazokende kotala.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Mpona kosangana na etuluku wana esengaka mbala mingi kotondisa kokomela makambo na mokanda na internet; atako bituluku mosusu epesaka to esengaka kolandela lisusu.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Bapesaka liste ya bayambi na nsima na papie to na ordinatere, ezalaka na bankombo mpe makanisi na bato mosusu oyo bazalaki kosala mobembo.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Kolalalala na bandako ya bato ebandaki na sanza ya yambo 2004 ntango moto ya mayele ya ordinatere Casey Fenton azwaki mpepo moko ya talo malamu mpona kokende na Islande kasi azalaki te na esika ya kolala.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Atindaki bana-kelasi ya universite ya mboka na bango e-mail mpe bato mingi mpenza batindelaki ye mikanda mpona kopesa ye esika ya kofanda ya ofele.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Ba hotel ya bilenge ezalaka mingimngi mpona bilenge – mbala mingi bakiliya bazalaka na mibu 20 na ndambu – kasi mbala mingi okoki pe kokuta mikolo oyo basali mibembo kuna.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Mabota oyo eza na bana bakutanaka na makambo, kasi bahotel mosusu endimaka bango na bachambre na bango moko.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Engumba ya Beijing na Chine yango nde ekoyamba masano ya Olympiques ya eleko ya mpio makasi ya 2022, ekosala ete ezala engumba ya liboso oyo eyambi masano ya Olympique ya eleko ya molunge mpe ya eleko ya mpio makasi.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beinjing ekosala milulu ya bufongoli, na ya bokangi, mpe masano ya likolo ya libanga ya malili ya kati ya ndako.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Komekama misusu ya ski ekosalema na esika ya kosala ski ya Taizicheng na Zhangjiakou, oyo eza pene ya 220 km (140 miles) ya Pékin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Batempelo ebele ezala na fete oyo basalaka mbala moko na mbula banda na suka ya sanza ya zomi na moko kino na katikati ya sanza ya mitano; ebongwanaka na kolanda kalandrie ya tempelo mokomoko.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Bafeti ebele ya tempelo basalaka yango na aniversere ya tempelo to na aniversere ya nzambe oyo ayangelaka to na molulu nyonso mosusu ya monene oyo eza na boyokani na tempelo.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Bafete ya tempelo ya Kerala ezalaka kitoko mingi na kotala, mpo balekisaka banzoku oyo bakomisi kitoko, orchestre ya tempelo mpe bafete mosusu.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Foire ya mokili mobimba (oyo babengaka mbala mingi foire ya mikili mingi, to kaka Foire) eza fete monene ya makambo ya mayemi mpe ya siansi ya mikili mingi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Bamboka oyo esanganaka elakisaki mayele mpe biloko ya koteya na bisika ya mboka mpona kolakisa mikakatano ya mokili mobimba to lisolo mpe mimeseno ya mboka wana.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Kolakisa bahorticoles ya mikili mingi ekoma milulu ya ntina mingi oyo elakisaka bafololo, bilanga ya kitoko mpe nyonso oyo etali banzete.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Atako na munoko ekoki kosalema mbala moko na mbula (soki esalemi na mikili mikeseni), na koloba solo esalemaka bongo te.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Mbala mingi milulu oyo esalaka basanza na kati ya misato mpe motoba, mpe esalemaka na bisika oyo eleki 50 hectare na monene.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Eza na lolenge mingi ya bafilme oyo basalela na eleko ya bambula mingi. Oyo basalelaka mingi eza filme 35 mm (36 na 24 mm na nsima) emonanaka mingi.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Mbala mingi bakoki kosangisa yango kozanga mpasi soki oza mokuse, mpe kosala ete ekokona na ndenge DSLR na yango ya sikoyo.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Ba apareyi ya foto misusu ya mike esalelaka format 6 cm na 6 cm, mingimingi na ndenge ya kozonga nsima 56 mm na 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Yango esalaka ete eloko wana eza monene mbala minei koleka 35 mm (3136 mm2 contre 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Banyama ya zamba eza na kati ya biloko ya mpasi mingi ya kokanga foto mpona moto akangaka foto, mpe esengeli kozala na libaku ya malamu, motema molai, mayele mpe bisaleli ebongi.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Mbala mingi bato bamonaka pamba foto ya banyama ya zamba, kasi neti bafoto nyonso, foto elobaka makambo mingi koleka maloba nkoto.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Mbala mingi mpona kokanga bafoto ya banyama esengaka kozala na zoom ya molai, kasi biloko neti etuluku ya bandeke to ya bikelamu mosusu ya mike esengaka zoom ya ndenge mosusu.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ezalaka mpasi na kozwa banyama mingi oyo eutaka na bamboka mosusu mpe ntango mosusu baparke baza na mibeko etali kokanga bafoto mpona ntina ya mombongo.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Banyama ya zamba bakoki kozala sonisoni to mobulu. Esika na bango ekoki kozala malili, moto, to mpasi na kofanda.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Mokili eza na balokota 5 000 ekeseni, ata pe balokota tuku mibale oyo bato 50 milio to mingi balobaka yango.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mbala mingi ezalaka pete ya kokanga ntina ya maloba oyo bakoma koleka oyo balobi. Eza solo mingimingi po ya ba adrese, oyo mbala mingi ezalaka mpasi na koloba yango malamu.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Bikolo mingi balobaka malamu Anglais, mpe na bikolo mosusu bato mingi bayebaka yango mwa ndambu - mingi bilenge.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Kanisa naino, soki okoki, moto moko ya Mancunien, moto moko ya Bostonien, moto moko ya Jamaïque na Sydneysider moko bafandi na mesa bazolya na malewa moko na Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bazali komisepelisa na masolo etali bamboka babotama, oyo bazobeta na elobeli na bango moko pe lokota na bango.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kosomba bilei na bazando ya minene ezalaka mbala mingi lolenge ya kosomba bilei na talo malamu. Kozanga kolanda, mabaku eza mingi te ya kozwa bilei oyo esi babongisi.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Mbala mingi, bazando ya minene ezokoma na biteni oyo batekaka bilei basi balamba. Misusu ezalaka na foure ya micro-ondes to lolenge mosusu ya kokomisa bilei moto.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Na bamboka misusu to lolenge ya bamagasin, bazalaka na malewa ata moko, mbala mingi ezalaka oyo eza na bilei ya talo malamu.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Sala mpe mema bakopi ya mlaako na yo mpe ya moto apesaki yo assurance.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Basengeli kolakisa adrese e-mail pe nimero ya telefone ya mikili mingi mpona kozwa toli/ndingisa pe kosenga oyo balingi.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Zala na mosusu na bifunda na yo mpe na internet (mitindela yango na e-mail na biloko oyo eza na kati, to bomba yango na "mapata").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Soki ozosala mobembo na ordinatere ya maboko to tablete, bomba kopi moko na memoire na yango to na diske (esika okoki kosalela yango ata internet eza te).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Pesa mpe bakopi ya malako/boyokani na baninga ya mobembo mpe bandeko to baninga oyo bakoki kosalisa.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Nyama ebengami elan (eyebani pe na nkombo ya elk) ebundisaka mpenza te, kasi bamibatelaka soki bamoni eloko oyo ezobangisa.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Soki bato bazomona te nyama ebengami elan lokola likama, bakoki kopusana mpenza pene na yango mpe komitia na likama.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bomela masanga na bokatikati. Masanga ezalaka na bopusi ndenge moko te na bato nyonso, pe eza ntina mingi oyeba esika osukaka.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Maladi ya ntango molai oyo moto akoki kobela soki azomela masanga mingi ezali maladi ya foie pe ata kofuta miso pe liwa. Likama ekomaki mingi soki moto azomela masanga oyo bapekisa.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Bilimo ya mabe ekoki kozala na biloko ya mbindo oyo eza likama ata pe méthanol, oyo ekoki koboma miso to koboma yo ata soki ozwi yango moke mpenza.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Maneti ekoki kozala talo moke na mikili ya bapaya, mingimingi na mikili ya bobola esika bafutaka bato ya mosala mbongo moke.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Kanisa kosala ekzame ya miso na ndako, mingimingi soki ekofutama na assurance, mpe komema ordonance mpona kotika yango esika mosusu.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Bakadre ya kitoko ya likolo ezali na bisika oyo ekoki kozala na makambo mibale; mosusu ekoki kozala ya mabe, mpe ya solo eza oyo euta mikili mosusu kasi ekoki kozala talo mingi koleka oyo basala na ndako.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kafe eza moko ya biloko oyo etambolaka mingi na mokili mobimba, pe okoki kokuta balolenge na yango mingi na mboka na bino.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Atako bongo, eza na lolenge mingi ekeseni ya komela kafe na mokili mobimba oyo ebongi mpenza komeka yango.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Kosala canoe (to: kosalela canoe) eza kokende na se ya canoe, oyo ezalaka ya kokauka to etondi na mai.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Kosala canoe esangisaka makambo ya kobeta mai, komata mpe kopumbwa - kasi esengaka ngalasisi mingi te to makasi mingi mpona kobanda (soki tokokanisi yango na ndakisa na komata bangomba, komibwaka longwa na esika ya likolo).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Kotambola libanda eza mosala oyo esengaka kotambola na bisika ya kitoko, mbala mingi na banzela ya kitoko.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Kotambola na moi esengaka kosala ntaka ya miles moko kino na ntaka monene oyo ekoki kozwa mokolo mobimba.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Mpona mokolo ya kotambola na nzela moko ya pete, komibongisa moke eza ntina pe moto nyonso oyo abongi moke akoki kosepela na yango.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Ekoki kosenga ete mabota oyo eza na bana ya mike bamibongisa mingi, kasi bakoki kolekisa mokolo moko na libanda ata soki baza na babebe pe bana bakoti naino kelasi te.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Na mokili mobimba, eza na bibongiseli pene ya 200 oyo eza na kosala. Mingi na yango esalaka yango moko.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Molandi ya Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours asali réseau eza na bafournisseur mingi ya sightrunning na bakontina minei.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Lokola eza na misisa na Running Tours Barcelona na Barcelone pe Running Copenhagen na Copenhague, mosusu esanganaki noki na yango na ndakisa Running Tours Prague oyo eza na Prague mpe misusu.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Eza na makambo ebele osengeli kotalela liboso kosala mobembo esika moko boye mpe ntango ozosala yango.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: ntango ozosala mobembo, yeba ete makambo ekozala te ndenge ezalaka "na mboka na yo". Bizaleli, mibeko, bilei, kotambola, sika ya kolala, malako, lokota pe makambo mosusu ekokesena mwa moke na ndenge eza na esika ofandaka.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Eza likambo oyo osengeli ntango nyonso kobosana te, po olemba nzoto te to mbala mosusu oyina te lolenge na bango ya kosala makambo.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Bakompani ya mibembo efungwama banda na ekeke ya 19. Kompani ya mobembo ezalaka mbala mingi liponi ya malamu mpona mobembo oyo ekosenga kotala makambo koleka oyo moto azosala mobembo amona na bozalisi, bokoko, lokota to mikili ya bobola.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Atako masanga mingi bazondima bato bakanga bisika, masanga mosusu eyebana na makambo mosusu etali mobembo, mbongo bakofuta to esika bakokende.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Ekoki kozala malamu na kosalela moto ya mosala oyo amesana kokanga bisika na mobembo oyo ekokani na ya yo.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Tala mibembo oyo mosali azopesa, ezala na site internet to na vitre ya fenetre.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Soki olingi komona mokili na talo moke, soki likoki eza, lolenge ya bomoi to makambo ya sika, eza na mwa ndenge ya kosala yango.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Na koloba solo, eza na lolenge mibale: Okoki kosala mosala ntango ozala mobembo to meka kosala badepanse moke. Lisolo oyo ezolobela mingi likanisi ya mibale.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Mpona bato oyo balingi kotika bomoi balingaka, ngonga, mpe bolamu na bango mpona kokitisa badepanse na bango pene ya libungutulu, tala mbongo moke esengi mpona mobembo.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Toli emonisi ete bato basalaki mibembo bayibaka te, basalaka mabunga te, basangaka te na koteka to kosomba biloko bapekisa, babondelaka te, to mpe babubaka te bato mosusu mpona matomba na bango moko.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Esika batalaka mikanda ya bato bazokende na mboka mopaya ezalaka esika ya liboso ya koleka soki okiti na mpepo, na masuwa to na motuka mosusu.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Na bingbunduka mosusu oyo ekendaka na bamboka mingi, batalaka mikanda na biloko na nzela ntango engbunduka ezotambola mpe osengeli kozala na identite ya malamu na maboko ntango ozomata na bingbunduka wana.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Na bingbunduka oyo ezalaka bambeto na butu, mokumbi akoki kozwa ba passeport mpo bakata yo te pongi na yo.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Kokomisa nkombo eza lisengami mosusu mpona kozwa viza. Na mikili mosusu, okoki kokomisa nkombo na yo na adrese ya esika okofanda epai ya bakonzi ya mboka.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Ekoki kosenga kotondisa mokanda na polisi ya mboka to kokende na biro ya immigration.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Na bamboka mingi oyo eza na mobeko wana, bahotel na bango bakipaka mosala ya kokomisa nkombo (kobosana te kotuna).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Na bandakisa mosusu, bato bakokomisa bankombo eza kaka bato oyo bakofanda te na bisika ya kolala babongiseli bapaya oyo bayei kotala mboka. Kasi, yango ezokomisa mobeko mabe koleka, yango wana luka koyeba liboso.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Mayele ya kotonga bandako (Architecture) etaleli kosala baplan ya bandako mpe kotonga yango. Mbala mingi architecture ya esika moko ebendaka mpenza likebi ya bato oyo bakendaka kotala bamboka ya bapaya.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Bandako mingi eza mwa kitoko na kotala mpe soki otali yango longwa na ndako moko ya molai to longwa na fenetre moko oyo eza na esika malamu, ezalaka kitoko mingi.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Architecture esangisaka mingi makambo mosusu na ndakisa kobongisa plan ya mboka, génie civil, mayele ya kokomisa biloko kitoko, midele ya kati mpe kobongisa kitoko ya bisika.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Na kotalela ndenge bapueblos mingi eza mosika, okokoka te komona biloko mingi oyo ezalaka na bomoi ya butu soki okei te na Albuquerque to na Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Kasi, bacasino nyonso oyo batie bankombo na yango likolo awa etekaka masanga, mpe mingi na yango ememaka masano ya malamu mpenza euti na bakompani ya minene (mingimingi ya minene oyo ezalaka zingazinga ya Albuquerque mpe Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Keba: babare ya bamboka ya mike ezalaka te ntango nyonso bisika ya malamu oyo bapaya bauti mboka mosusu basengeli kokende.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Kasi, nordi ya Nouveau-Mexique eza na mikakatano mingi ya kokumba motuka nsima ya komela masanga pe motango ya bashofere oyo bazokumba nsima ya komela eza mingi pene ya babare ya bingumba.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mayemi bapakoli to bakomi na bifelo, eyebana na nkombo ya graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Ata eza mpenza te makambo oyo esalemaka lelo, bato mingi basanganaka na bilei oyo basalaka mobulu pe babebisaka bandako ya bato na nzela ya langi ya aérosol.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Kasi, lelo eza na mayemi ya minene ya solo, milulu ya mayemi mpe mayemi "ya solo" na bifelo. Mbala mingi na bisika wana mayemi ekokanaka na mayemi kasi te na baetikete oyo bakoki kotanga.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Kobwaka boomerang eza mayele eyebana mingi oyo bato bakendaka kotala bamboka ya bapaya balingaka kozala na yango.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Soki olingi koyekola kosala boomerang oyo ezozongela yo na maboko, ekosenga ozala na boomerang ebongi mpo ezongaka.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Baboomerangs ebele oyo ezalaka na Australie ezongaka mpenza te. Eza malamu mingi mpona bato ya sika na komeka te komibwaka na mopepe.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Bilei ya Hangi elambamaka na libulu ya moto na mabele.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Bakomisaka libulu wana moto na mabanga ya moto oyo euti na moto, to na bisika mosusu, moto ya mabele esalaka ete esika yango ekoma moto.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Mbala mingi basalelaka hangi mpona kolamba bilei ya mboka na lolenge ya kotumba.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Bisika ebele ya Rotorua ezalaka na biloko ebengami hangi géothermiques, kasi bisika mosusu bakoki kosalela yango lokola bilembo na Christchurch, na Wellington pe na bisika mosusu.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail eza na biteni mibale na bingbunduka ya bamboka pe zingazinga ya Cap Town: MetroPlus (oyo babengaka pe First Class) pe Metro (oyo babengaka Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ezalaka kitoko mingi mpe na bato mingi te kasi ezalaka talo mwa mingi, atako talo na yango eza na se ya batike ya metro mingi ya Eropa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Engbunduka nyonso eza na baautocars MetroPlus na Metro; baautocars MetroPlus ezalaka ntango nyonso na suka ya engbunduka oyo eza pene na Cap Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Komibanza mpona basusu - Kotia te saki na yo na esika oyo okomona yango te, mingimingi soki ozokatisa bandelo ya mikili mingi.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Okoki komimona yo moko bafundi yo lokola moto amemi bilangwisela kozanga koyeba, oyo ekokotisa yo na bampasi mingi.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Ezalaka na molongo ya kozela, po bakoki kosalela bambwa oyo balukaki bilangwiseli ntango nyonso kozanga koyebisa liboso.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Bamboka mosusu baza na bitumba ya makasi mpenza, ata soki osali mpenza na mbala ya liboso; bitumba yango eza boloko ya bambula koleka 10 to liwa.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Basaki oyo bazokengela te, bakoyiba yango mpe ekoki kobenda likebi ya bakonzi mpo bakanisa ekoki kozala na bombe na kati.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Na ndako, mpona ndenge balakisaki biloko wana ya mboka, eza na chance mingi ete ekoki kosala yo mabe te.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Kasi na bisika mosusu na mokili, biloko ya zamba eza makambo ya sika mpona yo, eza polele ete okokutana na makambo.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Lisusu, na bisika ya molunge mikrobe ekolaka noki pe eumelaka mingi na libanda ya nzoto.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Yango wana maladi ya libumu ya Delhi, elakeli mabe ya Farao, kozongisa mabe ya Montezuma mpe baninga na bango mingi.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Ndenge ezalaka mpona makambo ya pema na bisika ya malili mingi, maladi ya misompona bisika ya molunge ezalaka mwa mingi mpe bato mingi bamitungisaka kasi ezalaka mpenza likama te.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Soki ozosala mobemoa mbala ya liboso na mokili ya bobola - to na esika ya sika na mokili - komona te pamba bokeseni makasi ya bizaleli.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Malako ya sika na makambo ya mibembo elekeli basali-mibembo mingi ya malamu mpe babongi, na bisika oyo makoki eza te ya kosala mbongwana nokinoki.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Mingimingi na mikolo na yo ya liboso, kanisa kosala bisalasala na bahotel ya poto ya kitoko makasi, na bilei pe misala ya kitoko po omesana.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Kolala te likolo ya matelas to ya coussin na mabele na bisika oyo oyebi te ndenge makambo ya mabele ezalaka.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Soki olingi kokende kofanda na camp, mema mbeto ya camp to hamac po ozala mosika na banioka, bankongoli mpe biloko mosusu.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Tondisa ndako na yo na kafe ya kitoko na ntongo mpe mwa ti ya malamu na butu.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Soki oza na conge, oza na ntango ya komisepelisa pe ya kozwa mwa miniti mpona kolamba bilei ya ntina.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Soki ozomona neti osekisaka bato mingi, zwa libaku ya komela jus to biloko basangisa:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mbala mosusu okomona masanga ya pete oyo okoki kosala mpona komela na ntongo ntango okozongela bizaleli ya mokolo na mokolo.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Soki ofandaka na engumba oyo bizaleli ya bato ya komela masanga ekeseni, kende na babare to na banganda oyo okendaka te mingi.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Mpona bato oyo bayebi te elobeli ya minganga, maloba epanzanaka mpe ezwaka basusu eza na ndimbola ekeseni.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Maladi oyo epanzanaka eza maladi oyo eutaka na patogene, na ndakisa virisi, mikrobe, mayebo, to biloko mosusu.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Maladi oyo epanzanaka eza maladi oyo ekoki kopesama na moto mosusu soki aza pene ya moto oyo aza na maladi wana.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Biyangeli mingi esengaka bapaya oyo bazokota, to bato oyo bazobima, na mikili na bango na kozwa mangwele ya maladi mingi.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Mbala mosusu masengami wana ekotalela mikili oyo moto azosala mobembo asi akende to azolinga kokende.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Likambo moko ya ntina mingi mpona Charlotte, Caroline ya nordi, eza ete eza na maponi ebele ya malamu mpona mabota.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Mbala mingi bato ya bisika mosusu batangaka bonkonde ya libota na kati ya makambo etindaka bango na kokende kuna, pe mbala mingi bapaya bamonaka ete engumba wana eza pete na kosepela kuna na bana.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Na mibu 20 euti koleka, motango ya maponi ebongi na bana na Uptown Charlotte ekoma ebele mpenza.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Mbala mingi, mabota ya Charlotte basalelaka te bataxi, kasi bakoki kozala ntina na bantango mosusu.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Kilo eleki mingi mpo balekisaki bato 2, yango wana liponi wana ekoki kosenga mosolo mingi koleka oyo osengeli kofuta.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctique eza esika ya malili koleka na mabele, mpe ezalaka zingazinga ya pole sudi.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Kokende kotala bamboka bapaya esengaka mbongo mingi, kozala nzoto kolongono, pe ekoki kosalema kaka na sanza ya zomi na moko kino ya mibale, pe esukaka kaka na esanga, na bisanga pe na mbu Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Mwa bankoto ya basali bafandaka awa na eleko ya molunge mingimingi na mwa bisika oyo; bato moke batikalaka na eleko ya malili.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarctique ya kati eza plateau oyo eza yango moko, eza na glace ya 2-3 km.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Bampepo mosusu oyo ekendaka ntango mosusu na bisika ya mabele, mpona komata bangomba to kokoma na songe, oyo eza na esika ya monene.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Kokatisa Pole sudi (to autoroute) eza nzela ya 1 600 km longwa na McMurdo na mbu ya Ross kino okokoma na Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Eza neige ya kokangama eza na madusu mpe eza na babendele. Mpo koleka kuna esengaka kosalela batracteurs ebongi, oyo ememaka essence na biloko mosusu.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Oyo eninganaka mpenza te yango wana nzela esengeli ekende kobaluka mosika na bangomba ya Transantarcti mpona kokoma na plateau.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Makambo oyo esalaka ete baaksida esalema mbala mingi na eleko ya mpio makasi eza banzela, bisika ya koleka (trottoirs) pe mingimingi bimateli ya muselu.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Osengeli kozala ata na basapatu oyo eza na basemele ebongi. Mbala mingi, basapatu ya eleko ya molunge esietaka na glace pe na neige, ata basapatu mosusu ya eleko ya mpio makasi ezalaka malamu te.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Modele esengeli kozala mozindo, 5 mm (1/5 inch) to mingi, mpe biloko esengeli kozala mwa pete mpona bisika ya malili makasi.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Babote mosusu eza na bacrampons mpe babakisaka yango kaka mpona bisika oyo esietaka, ebongi mpona basapatu mpe babote mingi, mpona batalons to batalon na semelle.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Batalon esengeli kozala ya se mpe minene. Mbala mingi zelo, mabanga ya mike to mungwa (chlorure ya calcium) epanzanaka na babalabala to na banzela mpona kobongisa yango.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Esopani ya neje eza mbeba te; bisika ekita ekoki kosimba kaka moke, mpe biloko oyo eleki ekokita lekola esopani ya neje.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Mokakatano eza ete neige eza ya kokangama, yango wana esengeli ata ndambu ekwea na se, mpe soki ndambu ya neige ekiti na se, ekoki kobenda oyo etikali.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ntango mosusu eloko ezalaki kobimisa makambo ezalaki moi ntango ezalaki kopanza neige, ntango mosusu neige mosusu ezalaki kokwea, ntango mosusu makambo mosusu ya bozalisi, mpe mbala mingi moto moko.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornade eza molongo ya mopepe oyo ezobaluka na pression ya nse, ebendaka mopepe ya zingazinga na kati mpe na libanda.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Ebimisaka mipepe ya makasi (mbala mingi 100-200 miles/ngonga) pe ekoki kotombola biloko ya minene likolo, komema yango ndenge mai ya mpela esalaka.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Ebandaka neti ba entonnoirs oyo ezokita uta na mipepe eza na mapata, pe ekomaka "mipepe makasi" ntango ekomaka na mabele.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Bapesi na yo ya VPN (réseau privé virtuel) na yo moko eza lolenge malamu ya kokima bolandeli ya bato ya politiki mpe ya mombongo IP oyo eyebaka esika moto azali.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Eleki ba proxys ya Web mpona bantina mingi: Ezongisaka biloko nyonso na Internet, kaka te http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ezalaka na nzela ya koleka to bande passante pe misala ya kitoko koleka. Ezali na bakode, yango eza mpasi po moto ayiba yango.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Mbala mingi bakompani oyo epanzaka basango ekosaka mpona mokano wana, balobaki te eza mpona "kozanga nzela na piratage".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ya solo, bakode ya bituka eza na bopusi ata moko te na kozwa biloko ya bato na ndenge ya mabe; kotia na diske moko biloko nyonso oyo eza na diske ya solo ekobeta kaka lokola oyo ya solo.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Mokano na yango eza ya kopesa bakompani wana boyangeli mingi na bazando; eza kaka makambo ya mbongo.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Lokola mabiangi ekangama makasi na Internet, oza te na mposa ya kosalela kompani ya telefone oyo eza na esika ofandaka to esika ozosala mobembo.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Eza na ntina te kozwa nimero ya esika wana na esika oyo ozali kofanda; okoki kozwa connection ya satelite ya internet na bazamba ya Chicken, Alaska pe na banimero mosusu oyo ezomonisa oza na moi ya Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Mbala mingi, osengeli kosomba nimero oyo ekabwana mpenza oyo epesaka batelefone PSTN likoki ya kobenga yo. Esika nimero euti ezalaka na ntina mingi mpona bato oyo babengi.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Baprograme ya kobongola maloba mbala moko – baprograme oyo ekoki kobongola mbala moko biteni milai ya maloba ya lokota moko na lokota mosusu.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ba application misusu ya lolenge oyo ekoki kobongola maloba ya minoko ya bapaya na bilembo, to na biloko mosusu na bomoi ya solo soki mosaleli alakisi smartphone na ye na ngambo ya biloko yango.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Baapplication ya kobongola maloba esala mbongwana mingi, pe sikoyo ebongalaka na ndenge ya mwa malamu (pe mbala mingi te buzoba), kasi esengeli kokeba, po ekoki kobongola makambo nyonso na ndenge ya mabe mpenza.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Moko ya ba application ya ntina mingi ya ndenge wana eza Google Translate, oyo esalisaka na kobongola makambo ata oza te na internet nsima ya kozwa basango nyonso ya lokota olingi.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Kosalela ba application ya koyeba bisika neti GPS na telefone na yo ekoki kozala lolenge ya pete pe ebongi mpenza ya kotambola soki oza te na mboka na yo.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Ekoki kosalisa na kobomba mbongo soki ozosomba bakarte ya sika mpona GPS, to GPs oyo esalaka yango moko to kodefa moko na kompani ya mituka oyo edefisaka yango.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Soki oza te na basango oyo eza connecte na telefone na yo, to soki eza mosika, ekosala malamu te to ekosala te.
