text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Babutiki nyonso ya pene ya balabala etondaki na bakarte ya telefone mingi mpenza oyo bakokaki kosalela na batelefone oyo bafutaka to na batelefone nyonso.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Atako soki bakarte mingi ekoki kosalisa na kobenga bisika nyonso, bato mosusu bazalaka na bakarte oyo ezalaka na batalo malamu mpona etuluku moko ya bamboka.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Mbala mingi bato bazwaka misala wana na nzela ya nimero ya telefone ya ofele oyo bakoki kobenga na batelefone mingi ya ofele.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Mibeko etali kokanga bafoto etalelaka pe kosala bavideo, kutu ata makambo mingi mosusu.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Soki kokanga foto ya pamba epesami te nzela, ebongo okoki kokanisi kutu kosala video na yango.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Soki ozosalela drone, luka koyeba liboso nini bakopesa yo nzela ya kokanga foto mpe bandingisa nini mosusu okozala na mposa na yango.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kopumbwisa drone pene ya aéroport to likolo ya bato ezalaka ntango nyonso likanisi mabe, ata soki bapekisaka yango te na mboka na bino.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Lelo, mpona mibembo ya mpepo, mbala mingi bakangaka te bisika na nzela ya kompani ya mpepo kozanga koluka mpe kokanisa batalo.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ntango mosusu mpepo wana moko ekoki kozala na batalo ekeseni na kotalela kompani oyo ezoteka batike pe ezalaka malamu kokokanisa ba resultat ya bolukiluki mpe lisusu kotala na site intenert ya kompani wana ya mpepo liboso okanga esika.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ata soki ekosenga te ozwa viza mpona baviziti ya mikuse na bamboka misusu mpona kokende kotala yango to mpona mombongo, kokende kuna lokoloa mwana-kelasi oyo auti mboka mosusu esengaka kofanda mingi kuna koleka kokende kuna kaka mpona kotala yango.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Mbala mingi, mpona kotikala na mokili moko ya bapaya na eleko ya molai, ekosenga ozwa viza liboso.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Mbala mingi baviza ya bana-kelasi ezalaka na masengami ekeseni mpe lolenge ya kosala yango ekeseni na koluka viza mpona kokende kotala mboka mopaya to mpona mombongo.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Mpona mikili mingi, okozala na mposa ya mokanda ya koluka bana-kelasi ya esika oyo olingi kokende kotanga, elongo na bilembeteli ya lisungi ya mbongo mpona kokokisa bamposa na yo na mbula ya liboso ya mateya.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Solola na lisanga, mpe ministere ya immigration ya mboka oyo olingi koyekola mpo oyeba makambo mingi.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Longola kaka soki oza diplomate, kosala na mboka mopaya elimbolaka mbala mingi tete okofuta mpako na mokili oyo ozafanda.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Mbongo euti ya mpako ekabolamaka na kolanda mboka mokomoko, mpe motango ya mpako mpe bampako ekeseni mingi mpenza na mboka moko na mosusu.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Na bamboka mosusu, na ndakisa na Etats-Unis mpe na Canada, balongolaka mpako na salere na leta pe na mboka, yango wana motango yango ekoki kokesena na etuka mokomoko.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Atako mbala mingi batalaka te mikanda ya bato to batalaka yango kaka bongobongo soki okomi na mboka na yo, kolandela makambo ya douane ekoki kozala motungisi monene.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Kobosana te koyeba oyo okoki kosala mpe okoki te kosala mpe loba makambo nyonso na kolanda mibeko.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Lolenge ya pete mpenza ya kobanda mosala ya kokoma makambo eza ya kokolisa mayele na yo na kosala bablog ya basite internet oyo eyebana.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Soki oyebi kosala formatage mpe kobongisa na web, na nsima, okoki kosala site internet na yo moko.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Komipesa na misala ya bolingo malamu ntango ozosala mobembo eza lolenge malamu ya kosala bokeseni kasi etali kaka kopesa te.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kofanda mpe kosala mosala ya bolingo malamu na mboka bapaya eza lolenge malamu ya koyeba bomoi na bango, kokutana na bato ya sika, koyekola komiyeba, koyeba makambo malamu pe koyekola mayele ya sika.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ekoki kozala mpe lolenge malamu ya kokomisa mosolo mingi mpona kosalisa na kosala mobembo ya mikolo mingi na esika moko boye po misala mingi ya bolingo malamu epesaka esika ya kolala mpe bilei mpe moko epesaka mwa salere.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Ba Vikings basalelaki banzela ya mai ya Russie mpona kokende na Mbu ya Moindo mpe na Mbu ya Caspienne. Biteni mosusu ya banzela wana bakoki kaka kosalela yango. Luka kozwa bandingisa ya ntina, oyo ekoki kozala mpasi na kozwa.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Nzela ya mbu ya mbu Blanche-Baltique esangisaka mbu ya Arctique na mbu ya Baltique, na nzela ya lac Onega, lac Ladoga pe Saint-Pétersbourg, mingimingi na bibale na balac.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lake Onega esanganaka mpe na Volga, yango wana likoki ezali ya kokoma na Mbu ya Caspian na nzela ya Russie.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ndima ete soki okomi na marinas, makambo nyonso ekokoma polele. Okokutana na bato mosusu pe bakokabola basango elongo na yo.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Na koloba solo, okotya mayebisi na yo ya kosenga lisalisi, okolekaleka na esika ya kokota na masuwa, okosolola na bato mpo osokola masuwa na bango, okomeka kokutana na basali ya masuwa na bar, mpe bongo na bongo.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Meka kosolola na bango mingi ndenge okoki. nsima ya mwa ntango bato nyonso bakoyeba yo mpe bakoyebisa yo masuwa nini bazoluka moto.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Osengeli kopona kompani na yo ya kosaola mobembo na mpepo na mayele mpenza.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Atako okoki kokanisi eza kaka malamu na kosala mobembo na mpepo omataka mingi, osengeli koyeba ete mbala mingi mabaku malamu oyo bapesaka ekeseni pe mbala mingi bapesaka bapoint mingi na bakompani mosusu ya nzela wana.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Bakompani ya mpepo neti Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines bakoma kosala mingi na Afrika, mpe bakendaka na bingumba mingi minene ya Afrika na batalo malamu koleka bakompani mosusu ya mpepo ya Eropa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines ezalaki kokende na bisika 39 na mikili ya Afrika 30 na 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Soki oza na ntango mosusu ya kosala mobembo, luka koyeba ndenge makambo na yo ya Afrika eza soki okokisi yango na bisika mosusu ya mokili.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Kobosana te kobakisa mosolo ya likolo mpona ba viza, bampako ya kokende, transport pe bongo na bongo mpona bisika yonso libanda ya Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Soki olingi kosala mobembo ya mpepo na bisika oyo eza mosika mpenza na sudi, maponi ya mpepo mpe ya bisika ya kokende eza mingi te po banzela oyo ekatisaka mbu eza moke.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Boyokani moko te ya likolo esalisaka na kokokatisa bambu nyonso misato na hémisphère ya sudi (mpe SkyTeam esalisaka na kokatisa ata moko te).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Kasi, Star Alliance ezwaka eteni wana mobimba longola Pacifique ya sudi este banda na Santiago ya Chilie kino Tahiti, oyo eza mobembo ya mpepo LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Masuwa wana eza te liponi moko pamba soki olingi koleka te na Pacifique ya Sudi mpe na ndambu ya Amerika ya Sudi. (tala na se)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Na 1994, etuka ya Haut-Karabakh ya Azerbaïdjan, oyo eza ya bamboka Arménie, esanganaki na bitumba mpona kobundisa baAzéris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Na lisungi ya Armenie, basalaki repiblike ya sika. Kasi, eza te ekolo eyebana - ata kutu Armenie - endimaka yango te.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Koswana ya bakonzi mpona etuka ezokoba kobebisa boyokani kati na Arménie na Azerbaïdjan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Etuka ya Canal (na néerlandais: Grachtengordel) eza etuka ya ekeke ya 17 oyo eyebana mingi, ezalaka zingazinga ya Binnenstad d'Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Baloba ete etuka mobimba eza Libula ya Mokili mobimba na UNESCO mpona bokoko na yango pe ntina na yango na masolo ya kala, pe ndako ya ntina mingi na kati ya bandako kitoko ya mboka.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, oyo elimbolia Mabele Mitano, eza na bamboka mitano ya mike ya pene ya mai Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso oyo eza na etuka ya Italie babengi Ligurie.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ezalaka na kati ya Libula ya Mokili Mobimba ya UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Na bikeke mingi, bato batonga na mayele mpenza baterrasses na bisika ya kitoko mingi oyo emema na mabanga oyo ezalaka pene ya mbu.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Ndambu ya kitoko na yango eza ndenge basalaka yango emonana mpenza te. Banzela, bingbunduka mpe masuwa esangisaka bamboka, mpe mituka ekoki kokoma kuna te longwa na libanda.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Balolenge ya Francais oyo balobaka na Belgique pe na Suisse ekeseni moke na Francais oyo balobaka na France, atako eza na boyokani makasi po bayokana ntango bazosolela.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Mingimingi, ndenge ya kokoma mintango na Belgique oyo balobaka Francais pe na Suisse eza na mwa bokeseni oyo eza ndenge moko te na Francais balobaka na France, pe ndenge babengaka maloba mosusu ekesanaka mpe.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Atako bongo, bato nyonso ya Belgique na ya Suisse oyo balobaka Francais bayekolaki yango na kelasi, yango wana bakoki koyeba makambo ozoloba soki osalelaki mayele ya kotanga mintango ya Francais.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Na bamboka ebele na mokili mobimba, kopepa loboko eza elombo ya malamu, oyo elakisi "boni."
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Kasi, na Malaisie, ata na kati ya bato ya Malaisie oyo bafandaka na bamboka, elimboli "yaka," ndenge moko na bilembo ya misapi basali ezotala ndambo ya nzoto, elembo oyo basaleka na mikili mosusu ya poto, pe basengeli kosalela yango kaka na ntina wana.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ndenge moko, moto moko ya Grande Bretagne oyo asalaki mobembo na Espagne akoki kokanisa na mabe ete kopepa loboko ya kopesa mbote, loboko ezotala moto apesi mbote (na esika etala moto oyo bazopepa) elimboli kozonga.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Balokota ya mike eza balokota oyo basala na likanisi ya kosalisa bato mpo basolola malamu; eloko oyo bato bakokaki ata moke te kosala soki yango ezalaki te.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Eza ya kokabwana na lingua francas, oyo eza na minoko ya malamu to ya organique oyo bato oyo balobaki minoko mosusu bakomaki kosalela mingi to ntina moko to mosusu.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Na mokolo ya moi makasi, bato bazosala mobembo bakoki komona bisika oyo ekoki kokosa bango neti eza mai (to biloko mosusu).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ekoki kozala likama soki moto azosala mobembo alandi eloko ekosi ye, mpe abebisi nguya ya ntina mpe mai oyo etikali.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ata bisobe ya molunge makasi ekoki kokoma malili mingi na butu. Okoki kobela maladi ya malili makasi soki olati bilamba ya kopesa yo molunge te.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Mingimingi na eleko ya molunge, ekosenga okeba mpona bangungi soki oponi kokende kotambola na bazamba ya tropicale.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ata soki ozokumba motuka na bazamba ya tropical subtropicale, kolekisa mwa basegonde moke libanda na baporte ya kofungwama ntango ozokota na motuka eza ngonga mingi po bangungi bamata elongo na yo na motuka.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Gripe ya bandeke, to oyo eyebani na nkombo ya gripe aviaire, ekoki kozwa bandeke na banyama.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Bamoni makambo na se ya nkoto moko na bato, kasi mosusu ebomaki bango.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Mingi etaleli bato oyo basalaka misala ya kobokola bibwele, kasi mosala ya kokanga bandeke ezalaka na mwa makama.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Bisika ya Norvege babengi fjords ya bangomba ya batswenge milai mpe mabwaku oyo epesaka nzela mbala moko na baplateau ya milai, minene to ya patatalu.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Mbala mingi babengaka ba plateau oyo "vidde" oyo elingi koloba monene, esika monene ezangi nzete, esika ezangi ndelo.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Na Rogaland pe na Agder, babengaka bango mbala mingi "hei" oyo elimboli nzela ezangi banzete oyo mbala mingi ezalaka na babruyère.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Baglace etelemaka te esika moko, kasi ekitaka na ngomba. Esalaka ete mabele epasuka, ebimisaka mabulu, oyo bagbagba ya neige oyo ekoki kobomba yango mpo emonana te.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Bifelo na likolo ya mabulu ya glace ekoki kokwea mpe bisika efungwama ekoki kokangama.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Na songe ya biloko ya komema baglace, biloko minene ezolongwa, ezokwea pe ezopumbwa to ezobaluka mwa mosika na songe.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Eleko ya kotala bamboka ya bapaya mpona kokende na bangumba mike ezalaka na bato ebele mbala mingi na eleko ya molunge na Inde.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Kasi, ezalaka na bonzenga mpe kitoko ya ndenge mosusu na eleko ya malili, pe bisika mingi na bangomba ezalaka na neige mingi mpe esalisaka na kosala misala neti ski na snowboard.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Kaka bakompani ya mpepo mike nde bazalaka na batalo ya liwa, oyo ekitisaka mwa moke batalo mpona matanga ya nokinoki.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Bakompani ya mpepo oyo esalaka yango eza Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa mpona mibembo babongisi uta na Etats-Unis, to na Canana, mpe WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Na bandakisa nyonso, osengeli kokanga esika mbala moko na kompani na nzela ya telefone na yo.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
